          (∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p ∣ Nat.card G → 8 * D + 4 < p) →

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.abstract_local_lemma
declarations.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq I] (p : Finset I → ℝ) (N : I → Finset I) (x : I → ℝ),
  p ∅ = 1 →
    (∀ (J : Finset I), 0 ≤ p J) →
      (∀ (i : I) (J K : Finset I), K ⊆ J → p J - p (insert i J) ≤ p K - p (insert i K)) →
        (∀ (i : I) (J : Finset I), i ∉ J → Disjoint J (N i) → p J - p (insert i J) = (1 - p {i}) * p J) →
          (∀ (i : I), 0 ≤ x i) →
            (∀ (i : I), x i < 1) → (∀ (i : I), 1 - p {i} ≤ x i * ∏ j ∈ N i, (1 - x j)) → ∀ (J : Finset I), 0 < p J

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.actual_expanded_tails_span
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Finite G] (a : G) (D : ℕ) (data : List (ℕ × G)) (hne : data ≠ [])
  (hC : DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGroup a D data hne ≤ DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)
  (hr :
    Function.Injective fun i =>
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) (DirectedCycles.cycleLabelPrefixes data i.castSucc))
  (hl : ∀ (i : Fin data.length), data[↑i].1 < orderOf ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a)),
  (∀ (i : Fin data.length), D ≤ data[↑i].1) →
    ∀ (Q : DirectedCycles.Cycle (DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGraph a D data hne)),
      DirectedCycles.SpansTruncation D
          (Set.range fun i =>
            (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) (DirectedCycles.cycleLabelPrefixes data i.castSucc)) →
        (∀ (z : ZMod (DirectedCycles.slotBaseline (DirectedCycles.cyclicLiftSlots a D data)).length),
            DirectedCycles.SpansTruncation D (DirectedCycles.auxiliaryLayerCoordinates a D data hne Q z)) →
          ∀ (R : DirectedCycles.Digraph G) (L : DirectedCycles.Cycle R),
            (have E := DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliary_expansionTemplate a D data hne hC hr hl Q;
              List.ofFn ⇑L.vertex = (List.ofFn fun e => List.ofFn (E.point e)).flatten) →
              L.ClosedUnderGenerator a → DirectedCycles.SpansTruncation D (L.generatorTails a)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.actual_fixed_fibre_mem
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Finite G] (a : G) (D : ℕ) (data : List (ℕ × G)) (hne : data ≠ [])
  (hC : DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGroup a D data hne ≤ DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)
  (hr :
    Function.Injective fun i =>
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) (DirectedCycles.cycleLabelPrefixes data i.castSucc))
  (hl : ∀ (i : Fin data.length), data[↑i].1 < orderOf ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a))
  (Q : DirectedCycles.Cycle (DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGraph a D data hne)) (R : DirectedCycles.Digraph G)
  (L : DirectedCycles.Cycle R),
  (have E := DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliary_expansionTemplate a D data hne hC hr hl Q;
    List.ofFn ⇑L.vertex = (List.ofFn fun e => List.ofFn (E.point e)).flatten) →
    L.ClosedUnderGenerator a →
      ∀ (W : AddSubgroup (DirectedCycles.TruncatedGroupRing G D)),
        (∀ x ∈ L.generatorTails a, (DirectedCycles.truncatedElement G D) x ∈ W) →
          ∀ (i : Fin data.length) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < data[↑i].1),
            DirectedCycles.SpansTruncation D
                (DirectedCycles.auxiliaryLayerCoordinates a D data hne Q
                  ((DirectedCycles.retainedLayerEquiv a D data hne) ⟨i, ⟨k, ⋯⟩⟩)) →
              ∀ (b : ↥(DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)),
                (DirectedCycles.truncatedElement G D) (↑b * DirectedCycles.runReference a D data i * a ^ k) ∈ W

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.actual_run_source_residue
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [Finite G] {ell : ℕ} (a : G) (D : ℕ) (l : Fin ell → ℕ) (s : Fin ell → G)
  (v : Fin ell → ZMod (orderOf ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a))),
  (∀ (i : Fin ell), ↑(DirectedCycles.runPrefixSum l D i.castSucc) + ↑(l i) = v i) →
    ∀ (i : Fin ell) (u : ℕ),
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a))
            (DirectedCycles.runReference a D (DirectedCycles.cycleRunData l s) ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩) *
          (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a ^ (l i + u) =
        DirectedCycles.residuePower ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a) (v i + ↑u) *
          (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) (List.take (↑i) (List.ofFn s)).prod

declarations.type:

      (∀ᶠ (t : ℝ) in nhds 0, HasDerivAt f (V (f t)) t) →

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.auxiliaryIndexConstant_pos
declarations.type: ∀ (r c n : ℕ), 0 < DirectedCycles.auxiliaryIndexConstant r c n

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.auxiliaryIndexExponent_pos
declarations.type: ∀ (r c n : ℕ), 0 < DirectedCycles.auxiliaryIndexExponent r c n

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.auxiliary_group_density_index
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Finite G] [Group.IsNilpotent G] (a : G) (r c n : ℕ),
  Group.rank G ≤ r →
    Group.nilpotencyClass G ≤ c →
      c ≤ n →
        ∀ (data : List (ℕ × G)) (hne : data ≠ []) (nu : ℤ),
          (Function.Injective fun i =>
              (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a))
                (DirectedCycles.cycleLabelPrefixes data i.castSucc)) →
            (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) (List.map Prod.snd data).prod =
                (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a ^ nu →
              ↑(Nat.card
                      (↥(DirectedCycles.elementClosure a) ⧸
                        (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a).subgroupOf (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a))) ∣
                  ↑(List.map (fun z => z.1 + (n + 1)) data).sum + nu →
                ↑((DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGroup a (n + 1) data hne).subgroupOf
                        (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)).index ≤
                  ↑(DirectedCycles.auxiliaryIndexConstant r c n) *
                    (↑(Nat.card (G ⧸ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) / ↑data.length) ^
                      DirectedCycles.auxiliaryIndexExponent r c n

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.auxiliary_group_eq_elementCommutators_of_spanning
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [Finite G] [Group.IsNilpotent G] (a : G) (n : ℕ),
  Group.nilpotencyClass G ≤ n →
    ∀ (data : List (ℕ × G)) (hne : data ≠ []) (nu : ℤ),
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) (List.map Prod.snd data).prod =
          (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a ^ nu →
        ↑(Nat.card
                (↥(DirectedCycles.elementClosure a) ⧸
                  (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a).subgroupOf (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a))) ∣
            ↑(List.map (fun z => z.1 + (n + 1)) data).sum + nu →
          AddSubgroup.closure
                (⇑(DirectedCycles.truncatedElement (G ⧸ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a) (n + 1)) ''
                  Set.range fun i =>
                    (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a))
                      (DirectedCycles.cycleLabelPrefixes data i.castSucc)) =
              ⊤ →
            DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGroup a (n + 1) data hne = DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.averageWeight_balanced
declarations.type:
∀ (G : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : Fintype V] [inst_3 : MulAction G V]
  (w : V → V → ℝ),
  (∀ (x y : V), ∃ g, g • x = y) →
    ∀ (x : V),
      DirectedCycles.outWeight (DirectedCycles.averageWeight G w) x =
        DirectedCycles.inWeight (DirectedCycles.averageWeight G w) x

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.averageWeight_capacity
declarations.type:
∀ (G : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : Fintype V] [inst_3 : MulAction G V]
  (w : V → V → ℝ) (a : ℝ),
  (∀ (x y : V), ∃ g, g • x = y) →
    ∑ x, ∑ y, w x y ≤ ↑(Fintype.card V) * a →
      ∀ (x : V),
        DirectedCycles.inWeight (DirectedCycles.averageWeight G w) x ≤ a ∧
          DirectedCycles.outWeight (DirectedCycles.averageWeight G w) x ≤ a

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.averageWeight_cutIn
declarations.type:
∀ (G : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : Fintype V] [inst_3 : DecidableEq V]
  [inst_4 : MulAction G V] (w : V → V → ℝ) (S : Finset V),
  DirectedCycles.cutIn (DirectedCycles.averageWeight G w) S =
    (∑ g, DirectedCycles.cutIn w (Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding (MulAction.toPerm g)) S)) / ↑(Fintype.card G)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.averageWeight_cutOut
declarations.type:
∀ (G : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : Fintype V] [inst_3 : DecidableEq V]
  [inst_4 : MulAction G V] (w : V → V → ℝ) (S : Finset V),
  DirectedCycles.cutOut (DirectedCycles.averageWeight G w) S =
    (∑ g, DirectedCycles.cutOut w (Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding (MulAction.toPerm g)) S)) / ↑(Fintype.card G)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.averageWeight_cut_lower
declarations.type:
∀ (G : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : Fintype V] [inst_3 : DecidableEq V]
  [inst_4 : MulAction G V] (w : V → V → ℝ) (S : Finset V) (L : ℝ),
  (∀ (g : G),
      L ≤
        DirectedCycles.cutOut w (Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding (MulAction.toPerm g)) S) +
          DirectedCycles.cutIn w (Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding (MulAction.toPerm g)) S)) →
    L ≤
      DirectedCycles.cutOut (DirectedCycles.averageWeight G w) S +
        DirectedCycles.cutIn (DirectedCycles.averageWeight G w) S

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.averageWeight_invariant
declarations.type:
∀ (G : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : MulAction G V] (w : V → V → ℝ) (a : G)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.averageWeight_nonneg
declarations.type:
∀ (G : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : MulAction G V] (w : V → V → ℝ),

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.averageWeight_support
declarations.type:
∀ (G : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : MulAction G V]
  (D : DirectedCycles.Digraph V) (w : V → V → ℝ),
  (∀ (g : G) (x y : V), D (g • x) (g • y) ↔ D x y) →
    (∀ (x y : V), ¬D x y → w x y = 0) → ∀ (x y : V), ¬D x y → DirectedCycles.averageWeight G w x y = 0

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.averageWeight_total
declarations.type:
∀ (G : Type u_1) {V : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : Fintype V] [inst_3 : MulAction G V]

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.badRunResidues_card

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.based_return_lifting
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {I : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Finite G] [Group.IsNilpotent G] [inst_3 : Fintype I]
  [DecidableEq I] (V : I → I → Set G) (a : G) (W : DirectedCycles.OrbitCycleWalk (DirectedCycles.VoltageDigraph V) a),
  (W.point 0).1 = 1 →
    DirectedCycles.StronglyConnected (DirectedCycles.VoltageDigraph V) →
      ∀ (r c n : ℕ),
        Group.rank G ≤ r →
          Group.nilpotencyClass G ≤ c →
            c ≤ n →
              8 * (Fintype.card I + 1) * (n + 1 + 1) <
                  orderOf ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a) →
                ∃ S,
                  (∀ s ∈ S, s ∉ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a) ∧
                    DirectedCycles.StronglyConnected
                        (DirectedCycles.CayleyDigraph (⇑(QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) '' S)) ∧
                      ∀
                        (C :
                          DirectedCycles.Cycle
                            (DirectedCycles.CayleyDigraph
                              (⇑(QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) '' S))),
                        Nonempty (DirectedCycles.ReturnLiftConstruction (DirectedCycles.VoltageDigraph V) a S C r c n)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.baseline_closure_of_congruence
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [Finite G] (a : G) (D : ℕ) (data : List (ℕ × G)) (nu : ℤ),
  (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) (List.map Prod.snd data).prod =

    ↑(Nat.card

              (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a).subgroupOf (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a))) ∣
        ↑(List.map (fun z => z.1 + D) data).sum + nu →
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a ^ (List.map (fun z => z.1 + D) data).sum *

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.boundary_lower_bound_of_weights
declarations.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype V] [inst_1 : DecidableEq V] (D : DirectedCycles.Digraph V) (w : V → V → ℝ)
  (S : Finset V) (a L : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    (∀ (x y : V), 0 ≤ w x y) →
      (∀ (x y : V), ¬D x y → w x y = 0) →
        (∀ (x : V), DirectedCycles.outWeight w x = DirectedCycles.inWeight w x) →
          (∀ (x : V), DirectedCycles.inWeight w x ≤ a) →
            (∀ (x : V), DirectedCycles.outWeight w x ≤ a) →
              2 * L ≤ DirectedCycles.cutOut w S + DirectedCycles.cutIn w S →
                L / a ≤ ↑(DirectedCycles.outBoundary D S).card ∧ L / a ≤ ↑(DirectedCycles.inBoundary D S).card

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.boundedDerivative_bddAbove
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] {f : G → ℝ} {K : ℝ},
  (∀ (x : G), |f x| ≤ K) → ∀ (g : G), BddAbove (Set.range fun x => |DirectedCycles.groupDerivative g f x|)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.boundedDerivative_commutator_bound
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] {f : G → ℝ} {K : ℝ},
  (∀ (x : G), |f x| ≤ K) →
    ∀ (g h : G) {A B : ℝ},
      (∀ (x : G), |DirectedCycles.groupDerivative g (DirectedCycles.groupDerivative h f) x| ≤ A) →
        (∀ (x : G), |DirectedCycles.groupDerivative h (DirectedCycles.groupDerivative g f) x| ≤ B) →
          DirectedCycles.boundedDerivative f (g⁻¹ * h⁻¹ * g * h) ≤ A + B

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.boundedDerivative_le_escape_of_second
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] {f : G → ℝ} {K : ℝ},
  0 ≤ K →
    (∀ (x : G), |f x| ≤ K) →
      ∀ (g : G) {S : Set G},
        1 ∈ S →
          ∀ {R : ℝ},
            0 ≤ R →
              (∀ h ∈ S, ∀ (x : G), |DirectedCycles.groupDerivative h (DirectedCycles.groupDerivative g f) x| ≤ R) →
                DirectedCycles.boundedDerivative f g ≤ 4 * K * DirectedCycles.escapeNorm S g + R

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.boundedDerivative_le_iff
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] {f : G → ℝ} {K : ℝ},

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.bounded_gleason_bootstrap_core
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] {A S : Set G},
  1 ∈ A →
    1 ∈ S →
      ∀ {ε C K M θ : ℝ},
        0 < ε →
          0 ≤ C →
            1 ≤ K →
              1 ≤ M →
                0 ≤ θ →
                  θ ≤ 1 / 2 →
                    ∀ (f : G → ℝ),
                      (∀ (x : G), |f x| ≤ K) →
                        (∀ (g : G), DirectedCycles.escapeNorm A g ≤ C * DirectedCycles.boundedDerivative f g) →
                          (∀ (g : G), DirectedCycles.escapeNorm S g ≤ M * DirectedCycles.escapeNorm A g) →
                            (∃ X,
                                0 ≤ X ∧
                                  ∀ (g : G),
                                    DirectedCycles.boundedDerivative f g ≤
                                      X * DirectedCycles.regularizedEscapeDistance A ε g) →
                              (∀ (X : ℝ),
                                  0 ≤ X →
                                    (∀ (g : G),
                                        DirectedCycles.boundedDerivative f g ≤
                                          X * DirectedCycles.regularizedEscapeDistance A ε g) →
                                      ∀ g ∈ A,
                                        ∀ h ∈ S,
                                          ∀ (x : G),
                                            |DirectedCycles.groupDerivative h (DirectedCycles.groupDerivative g f) x| ≤
                                              θ * X * DirectedCycles.regularizedEscapeDistance A ε g) →

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.bounded_prime_cayley_density
declarations.type:
∀ (r c n : ℕ),
  c ≤ n →
    ∀ (base lower theta : ℝ),
      0 < base →
        base ≤ 1 →
          0 < lower →
            0 ≤ theta →
              (∀ (H : Type u) [inst : Group H] [inst_1 : Finite H] [Group.IsNilpotent H],
                  Group.rank H ≤ r →
                    Group.nilpotencyClass H ≤ c →
                      DirectedCycles.AbovePrimeCutoff H (n + 1) →
                        DirectedCycles.CayleySpanningBound H (n + 1) base theta) →
                (∀ (H : Type u) [inst : Group H] [inst_1 : Finite H] [Group.IsNilpotent H],
                    Group.rank H ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range c, r ^ (i + 1) →
                      Group.nilpotencyClass H ≤ c / 2 → DirectedCycles.LayerCycleLowerBound H lower theta) →
                  ∀ (t : ℕ) (G : Type u) [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Finite G] [Group.IsNilpotent G] [Nontrivial G],
                    Group.rank G ≤ r →
                      Group.nilpotencyClass G ≤ c →
                        DirectedCycles.primeBudget G (8 * (n + 1) + 4) ≤ t →
                          ∀ (S : Set G),
                            Subgroup.closure S = ⊤ →
                              have k := DirectedCycles.auxiliaryIndexExponent r c n + 1;
                              have d := lower / (4 * ↑(DirectedCycles.auxiliaryIndexConstant r c n));
                              have M := ↑((8 * (n + 1) + 4) ^ (c * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range c, r ^ (i + 1)));
                              ∃ C,
                                DirectedCycles.budgetConstant base d M k t * ↑(Nat.card G) ^ (-(theta * ↑k ^ t)) ≤
                                  ↑C.length / ↑(Nat.card G)

                        ∀ (N : Subgroup G),

                                  N.index ≤ Q →
                                    (∀ (x : V), Nat.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer G x) ≤ B) →

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.choose_collision_separated_runs
declarations.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} {H : Type u_3} [inst : Group H] [inst_1 : Fintype I] [inst_2 : Fintype K]
  [DecidableEq I] (h q D : ℕ) [NeZero h],
  8 * (q + 1) * (D + 1) < h →
    Fintype.card K ≤ q →
      ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm I),
        (∀ (i : I), σ i ≠ i) →
          ∀ (start finish : I ↪ H) (label : K → H) (e : DirectedCycles.RightCollision start finish label → ZMod h)
            (ν : I → ZMod h) (i₀ : I),
            ∃ v l,
              v (σ i₀) + ↑D + ν i₀ = 0 ∧
                (∀ (i : I), l i = (v i - v (σ i) - (↑D + ν i)).val) ∧
                  (∀ (i : I), D ≤ l i ∧ (h + 7) / 8 ≤ l i ∧ l i ≤ h - 2 * D - 2) ∧
                    ∑ i, (↑(l i) + ↑D) + ∑ i, ν i = 0 ∧
                      Fintype.card I * h ≤ 8 * ∑ i, (l i + 1) ∧
                        ∀ (c : DirectedCycles.RightCollision start finish label),
                          v (↑c).2.2 - v (↑c).2.1 ∉ DirectedCycles.collisionForbiddenResidues h D (e c)

  2 ≤ ell →
    ∀ [NeZero h],

        Fintype.card K ≤ q →
          ∀ (start finish : Fin ell ↪ H) (label : K → H) (e : DirectedCycles.RightCollision start finish label → ZMod h)
            (ν : ℤ),
            ∃ v l,
              (∀ (i : Fin ell), D ≤ l i ∧ (h + 7) / 8 ≤ l i ∧ l i ≤ h - 2 * D - 2) ∧
                ↑h ∣ ↑(∑ i, (l i + D)) + ν ∧
                  ell * h ≤ 8 * ∑ i, (l i + 1) ∧
                    (∀ (i : Fin ell), ↑(DirectedCycles.runPrefixSum l D i.castSucc) + ↑(l i) = v i) ∧
                      (∀ (i : Fin ell),
                          ↑(l i) = v i - v ((Equiv.symm (finRotate ell)) i) - ↑D - if ↑i = 0 then ↑ν else 0) ∧
                        ∀ (c : DirectedCycles.RightCollision start finish label),

        (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, u i ^ N i ∉ A i) →

              ∀ v ∈ A i, v ≠ 1 → DirectedCycles.escapeNorm (A i) (u i) ≤ DirectedCycles.escapeNorm (A i) v) →
            ∀ {D : ℝ},
              0 ≤ D →
                (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U,
                    ∀ x ∈ A i,
                      DirectedCycles.escapeNorm (A i) (x⁻¹ * (u i)⁻¹ * x * u i) ≤
                        D * DirectedCycles.escapeNorm (A i) x * DirectedCycles.escapeNorm (A i) (u i)) →
                  ∀ (π : ↥(Subgroup.closure (DirectedCycles.ultraSet (↑U) G A)) →* H),
                    Function.Surjective ⇑π →
                      ∀ (V : Set H),
                        IsCompact V →
                          (∀ (x : H), (∀ (n : ℕ), x ^ n ∈ V) → x = 1) →
                            (∀ (x : ↥(Subgroup.closure (DirectedCycles.ultraSet (↑U) G A))),
                                ↑x ∈ DirectedCycles.ultraSet (↑U) G A → π x ∈ V) →
                              ∀ (W : Set H),
                                IsOpen W →
                                  1 ∈ W →
                                    (∀ (x : ↥(Subgroup.closure (DirectedCycles.ultraSet (↑U) G A))),
                                        π x ∈ W → ↑x ∈ DirectedCycles.ultraSet (↑U) G A) →
                                      ∃ φ,
                                        Continuous φ ∧
                                          φ 0 = 1 ∧
                                            (∀ (s t : ℝ), φ (s + t) = φ s * φ t) ∧

                                                (∀ (t : ℝ),

                                                        Subgroup.closure (DirectedCycles.ultraSet (↑U) G A)),

                                                  ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : H), Commute (φ t) x

                                                                (DirectedCycles.ultraSet (↑U) G A)).subtype ⁻¹'
                                                          DirectedCycles.ultraSet (↑U) G fun i =>

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.connector_endpoints_separated
declarations.type:
∀ {Q : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} {I : Type u_3} [inst : Group Q] [inst_1 : Group H] (a : Q) [NeZero (orderOf a)],
  a ∈ Subgroup.center Q →
    ∀ (p : Q →* H),
      p a = 1 →
        ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm I) (start finish : I → Q),
          (Function.Injective fun i => p (start i)) →
            ∀ (v ν : I → ZMod (orderOf a)) (l : I → ℕ) (D : ℕ),
              (∀ (i : I), finish (σ i) = DirectedCycles.residuePower a (ν i) * start i) →
                (∀ (i : I), ↑(l i) = v i - v (σ i) - ↑D - ν i) →
                  (∀ (i : I), 1 ≤ l i ∧ l i ≤ orderOf a - 2 * D - 2) →
                    2 * D + 2 ≤ orderOf a →
                      ∀ (i j : I) (u u' ε : ℕ),
                        u ≤ D →
                          u' ≤ D →
                            ε ≤ 1 →
                              DirectedCycles.residuePower a (v j + ↑u') * finish j ≠
                                DirectedCycles.residuePower a (v i + ↑u) * start i * a ^ ε

  (∀ (j : Fin (D + 1)), ↑(mu j) = p * DirectedCycles.connectorWord a s D ↑j * r⁻¹) →
    (∀ (j : Fin (D + 1)), mu j ∈ C) →
      (∃ k ∈ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a, p = k * g) →
        ∃ m,
          ∀ j < D,
            (DirectedCycles.representationEquiv
                    (DirectedCycles.normalAbelianAction (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a ^
                  (m + ↑j))
                (DirectedCycles.elementCocycle a g - DirectedCycles.elementCocycle a (g * s)) ∈
              Subgroup.toAddSubgroup (Subgroup.map Abelianization.of C)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.connector_mixed_separated
declarations.type:
∀ {Q : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} {I : Type u_3} {K : Type u_4} [inst : Group Q] [inst_1 : Group H] (a : Q)
  [NeZero (orderOf a)] (p : Q →* H),
  p a = 1 →
    ∀ (start finish : I → Q) (hs : Function.Injective fun i => p (start i))
      (hf : Function.Injective fun i => p (finish i)) (t : K → Q)
      (e :
        (DirectedCycles.RightCollision { toFun := fun i => p (start i), inj' := hs }
            { toFun := fun i => p (finish i), inj' := hf } fun k => p (t k)) →
          ZMod (orderOf a)),
      (∀
          (c :
            DirectedCycles.RightCollision { toFun := fun i => p (start i), inj' := hs }
              { toFun := fun i => p (finish i), inj' := hf } fun k => p (t k)),
          start (↑c).2.1 * t (↑c).1 * (finish (↑c).2.2)⁻¹ = DirectedCycles.residuePower a (e c)) →
        ∀ (D : ℕ) (v : I → ZMod (orderOf a)),
          (∀
              (c :
                DirectedCycles.RightCollision { toFun := fun i => p (start i), inj' := hs }
                  { toFun := fun i => p (finish i), inj' := hf } fun k => p (t k)),
              v (↑c).2.2 - v (↑c).2.1 ∉ DirectedCycles.collisionForbiddenResidues (orderOf a) D (e c)) →
            ∀ (i j : I),
              i ≠ j →

declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Finite G] [Group.IsNilpotent G] (a : G) (r c n ell : ℕ),

    Group.nilpotencyClass G ≤ c →
      c ≤ n →
        0 < ell →
          ∀ (C : Subgroup ↥(DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) (g : Fin (ell + 1) → G) (s p t : Fin ell → G),
            g 0 = 1 →
              (∀ (i : Fin ell), g i.succ = g i.castSucc * s i) →
                (Function.Injective fun i => (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) (g i.castSucc)) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin ell), ∃ k ∈ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a, p i = k * g i.castSucc) →
                    ∀ (mu : Fin ell → Fin (n + 1 + 1) → ↥(DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)),
                      (∀ (i : Fin ell) (j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)),
                          ↑(mu i j) = p i * DirectedCycles.connectorWord a (s i) (n + 1) ↑j * (t i)⁻¹) →
                        (∀ (i : Fin ell) (j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)), mu i j ∈ C) →
                          ↑C.index ≤
                            ↑(DirectedCycles.auxiliaryIndexConstant r c n) *
                              (↑(Nat.card (G ⧸ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) / ↑ell) ^

      g 0 = 1 →
        (∀ (i : Fin ell), g i.succ = g i.castSucc * s i) →
          (∀ (i : Fin ell), ∃ k ∈ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a, p i = k * g i.castSucc) →

                  ↑(mu i j) = p i * DirectedCycles.connectorWord a (s i) (n + 1) ↑j * (t i)⁻¹) →
                (∀ (i : Fin ell) (j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)), mu i j ∈ C) →
                  AddSubgroup.closure
                        (⇑(DirectedCycles.truncatedElement (G ⧸ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a) (n + 1)) ''

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.cycle_of_return_edge_paths
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {I : Type u_2} {K : Type u_3} [inst : Group G] {R : DirectedCycles.Digraph G} (S : I → I → Set G)

          (∀ z ∈ Q₀, z ≠ root → t z = a) →
            ∀ (A : DirectedCycles.SimplePath (DirectedCycles.VoltageDigraph S) (1, root) (a, root)),
              (∀ (x : G), ∀ z ∈ (A.translateRoot x).vertices.dropLast, z.1 = x ∧ z.2 ∈ Q₀) →
                ∀ (label : K → G)
                  (P : (k : K) → DirectedCycles.SimplePath (DirectedCycles.VoltageDigraph S) (1, root) (label k, root)),
                  (∀ (k : K), ∀ z ∈ (P k).vertices, z.1 = 1 ∨ z.1 = label k * (t z.2)⁻¹) →
                    ∀ (pick : (e : Fin C.length) → C.vertex ((finRotate C.length) e) ≠ C.vertex e * a → K),
                      (∀ (e : Fin C.length) (h : C.vertex ((finRotate C.length) e) ≠ C.vertex e * a),
                          C.vertex ((finRotate C.length) e) = C.vertex e * label (pick e h)) →
                        (∀ (i j : Fin C.length),
                            i ≠ j →
                              ∀ (hi : C.vertex ((finRotate C.length) i) ≠ C.vertex i * a)
                                (hj : C.vertex ((finRotate C.length) j) ≠ C.vertex j * a),
                                ((P (pick i hi)).translateRoot (C.vertex i)).vertices.Disjoint
                                  ((P (pick j hj)).translateRoot (C.vertex j)).vertices) →
                          ∃ L, C.length ≤ L.length

  (∀ (g : G) (x y : V), D (g • x) (g • y) ↔ D x y) →
    (∀ (x y : V), ∃ g, g • x = y) →
      ∀ (t : ℕ),
        (∀ (x y : V), ∃ P, P.length ≤ t) →
          192 * (t + 1) ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card V → ∃ C, ↑(Fintype.card V) / (96 * (↑t + 1) ^ 2) ≤ ↑C.length

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGroup_le
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (a : G) (D : ℕ) (data : List (ℕ × G)) (hne : data ≠ []),
  (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a ^ (List.map (fun z => z.1 + D) data).sum *
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) (List.map Prod.snd data).prod =
      1 →
    DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGroup a D data hne ≤ DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGroup_le_of_congruence
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [Finite G] (a : G) (D : ℕ) (data : List (ℕ × G)) (hne : data ≠ []) (nu : ℤ),
  (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) (List.map Prod.snd data).prod =
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a ^ nu →
    ↑(Nat.card
            (↥(DirectedCycles.elementClosure a) ⧸
              (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a).subgroupOf (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a))) ∣
        ↑(List.map (fun z => z.1 + D) data).sum + nu →
      DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGroup a D data hne ≤ DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliary_connector_data
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (a : G) (D : ℕ) (data : List (ℕ × G)) (hne : data ≠ []),
  (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a ^ (List.map (fun z => z.1 + D) data).sum *
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) (List.map Prod.snd data).prod =
      1 →
    ∃ p t mu,
      (∀ (i : Fin data.length),
          ∃ k ∈ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a, p i = k * DirectedCycles.cycleLabelPrefixes data i.castSucc) ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin data.length) (j : Fin (D + 1)),
            ↑(mu i j) = p i * DirectedCycles.connectorWord a data[↑i].2 D ↑j * (t i)⁻¹) ∧
          ∀ (i : Fin data.length) (j : Fin (D + 1)),
            mu i j ∈ (DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGroup a D data hne).subgroupOf (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliary_edge_words
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (a : G) (D : ℕ) (data : List (ℕ × G)) (hne : data ≠ [])
  (x y :
    ↥(DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGroup a D data hne) ×
      ZMod (DirectedCycles.slotBaseline (DirectedCycles.cyclicLiftSlots a D data)).length),
  DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGraph a D data hne x y →
    let p := (DirectedCycles.retainedLayerEquiv a D data hne).symm x.2;
    have rx :=
      DirectedCycles.normalizedRealization (DirectedCycles.slotBaseline (DirectedCycles.cyclicLiftSlots a D data))
        (↑x.1, x.2);
    have ry :=
      DirectedCycles.normalizedRealization (DirectedCycles.slotBaseline (DirectedCycles.cyclicLiftSlots a D data))
        (↑y.1, y.2);
    ∃ j,
      (↑p.snd < data[↑p.fst].1 → ry = rx * a) ∧
        (↑p.snd = data[↑p.fst].1 → ry = rx * a ^ ↑j * data[↑p.fst].2 * a ^ (D - ↑j))

∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (a : G) (D : ℕ) (data : List (ℕ × G)) (hne : data ≠ [])

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliary_realization_injective
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [Finite G] (a : G) (D : ℕ) (data : List (ℕ × G)) (hne : data ≠ []),
  DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGroup a D data hne ≤ DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a →
    (Function.Injective fun i =>
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) (DirectedCycles.cycleLabelPrefixes data i.castSucc)) →
      (∀ (i : Fin data.length), data[↑i].1 < orderOf ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a)) →
        Function.Injective fun v =>
          DirectedCycles.normalizedRealization (DirectedCycles.slotBaseline (DirectedCycles.cyclicLiftSlots a D data))
            (↑v.1, v.2)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliary_realization_projection
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (a : G) (D : ℕ) (data : List (ℕ × G)) (hne : data ≠ []),
  DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGroup a D data hne ≤ DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a →
    ∀
      (v :
        ↥(DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGroup a D data hne) ×
          ZMod (DirectedCycles.slotBaseline (DirectedCycles.cyclicLiftSlots a D data)).length),
      have p := (DirectedCycles.retainedLayerEquiv a D data hne).symm v.2;
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a))
          (DirectedCycles.normalizedRealization (DirectedCycles.slotBaseline (DirectedCycles.cyclicLiftSlots a D data))
            (↑v.1, v.2)) =
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) (DirectedCycles.runReference a D data p.fst) *
          (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a ^ ↑p.snd

  (hQ : ∀ (g : G) (a b : W), Q (g • a) (g • b) ↔ Q a b) (hπ : ∀ (g : G) (x : V), π (g • x) = g • π x)
  (base : (x y : V) → Q (π x) (π y) → DirectedCycles.SimplePath D x y) {n : ℕ} (A : Fin n → W)
  (hA : ∀ (i : Fin n), Q (A i) (A ((finRotate n) i))) (i : Fin n),

declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : MulAction G V] [inst_2 : MulAction G W]
  {D : DirectedCycles.Digraph V} (Q : DirectedCycles.Digraph W) (π : V → W)
  (hQ : ∀ (g : G) (a b : W), Q (g • a) (g • b) ↔ Q a b) (hπ : ∀ (g : G) (x : V), π (g • x) = g • π x)
  (base : (x y : V) → Q (π x) (π y) → DirectedCycles.SimplePath D x y) (t : ℕ),
  (∀ (x y : V) (h : Q (π x) (π y)), (base x y h).length ≤ t) →

      (ω : (j : Fin n) → DirectedCycles.EndpointSeed π A j),
      (DirectedCycles.cyclicSampledPath Q π hQ hπ base A hA i ω).length ≤ t + 1

  {D : DirectedCycles.Digraph V},
  (∀ (g : G) (x y : V), D (g • x) (g • y) ↔ D x y) →
    ∀ (Q : DirectedCycles.Digraph W) (π : V → W) (hQ : ∀ (g : G) (a b : W), Q (g • a) (g • b) ↔ Q a b)
      (hπ : ∀ (g : G) (x : V), π (g • x) = g • π x) (base : (x y : V) → Q (π x) (π y) → DirectedCycles.SimplePath D x y)
      {n : ℕ} (A : Fin n → W) (hA : ∀ (i : Fin n), Q (A i) (A ((finRotate n) i)))

declarations.type:

  [inst_3 : DecidableEq W] [inst_4 : MulAction G V] [inst_5 : MulAction G W] {D : DirectedCycles.Digraph V}
  (Q : DirectedCycles.Digraph W) (π : V → W),
  Function.Surjective π →
    ∀ (hQ : ∀ (g : G) (a b : W), Q (g • a) (g • b) ↔ Q a b) (hπ : ∀ (g : G) (x : V), π (g • x) = g • π x)
      (base : (x y : V) → Q (π x) (π y) → DirectedCycles.SimplePath D x y) {n : ℕ},

        ∀ (A : Fin n → W) (hA : ∀ (i : Fin n), Q (A i) (A ((finRotate n) i))) (i : Fin n) (v : V),

  DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGroup a D data hne ≤ DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a →
    (Function.Injective fun i =>
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) (DirectedCycles.cycleLabelPrefixes data i.castSucc)) →
      (∀ (i : Fin data.length),
          data[↑i].1 + 2 * D + 2 ≤ orderOf ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a)) →
        ∀ (S : Set G),
          a ∈ S →
            (∀ (i : Fin data.length), data[↑i].2 ∈ S) →
              ∀ (Q : DirectedCycles.Cycle (DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGraph a D data hne)),
                ∃ C, Q.length ≤ C.length ∧ C.ClosedUnderGenerator a

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.cyclic_auxiliary_cycle_expands_with_edge_data
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [Finite G] (a : G) (D : ℕ) (data : List (ℕ × G)) (hne : data ≠ []),
  DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGroup a D data hne ≤ DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a →
    (Function.Injective fun i =>
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) (DirectedCycles.cycleLabelPrefixes data i.castSucc)) →
      (∀ (i : Fin data.length),
          data[↑i].1 + 2 * D + 2 ≤ orderOf ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a)) →
        ∀ (S : Set G),
          a ∈ S →
            (∀ (i : Fin data.length), data[↑i].2 ∈ S) →
              ∀ (Q : DirectedCycles.Cycle (DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGraph a D data hne)),
                ∃ C,
                  Q.length ≤ C.length ∧
                    C.ClosedUnderGenerator a ∧
                      ∀ (i : Fin C.length),
                        C.vertex ((finRotate C.length) i) = C.vertex i * a ∨
                          ∃ p,
                            ∃ u ≤ D,
                              C.vertex ((finRotate C.length) i) = C.vertex i * data[↑p].2 ∧
                                (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) (C.vertex i) =
                                  (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a))
                                      (DirectedCycles.runReference a D data p) *
                                    (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a ^ (data[↑p].1 + u)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.cyclic_lift_construction
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [Finite G] (a : G) (D : ℕ) (data : List (ℕ × G)) (hne : data ≠ []) (nu : ℤ),
  (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) (List.map Prod.snd data).prod =
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a ^ nu →
    ↑(Nat.card
            (↥(DirectedCycles.elementClosure a) ⧸
              (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a).subgroupOf (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a))) ∣
        ↑(List.map (fun z => z.1 + D) data).sum + nu →
      (DirectedCycles.slotBaseline (DirectedCycles.cyclicLiftSlots a D data)).length =
          (List.map (fun z => z.1 + 1) data).sum ∧
        DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGroup a D data hne ≤ DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a ∧
          DirectedCycles.StronglyConnected (DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGraph a D data hne) ∧
            DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGroup a D data hne =
              Subgroup.closure
                (DirectedCycles.normalizedRelativeLabels (DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryLabels a D data hne)
                  (DirectedCycles.normalizedBaseline
                    (DirectedCycles.slotBaseline (DirectedCycles.cyclicLiftSlots a D data))))

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.cyclic_nss_neighbourhood_of_differentiable_coordinates
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_3 : NormedSpace ℝ E] (chart : G → E) (unchart : E → G),
  ∀ V ∈ nhds 1,
    ContinuousAt chart 1 →
      chart 1 = 0 →
        unchart 0 = 1 →
          (∀ x ∈ V, unchart (chart x) = x) →
            (fun x => chart (unchart x)) =ᶠ[nhds 0] id →
              DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun p => chart (unchart p.1 * unchart p.2)) (0, 0) →
                ∃ W ∈ nhds 1, ∀ (x : G), (∀ (n : ℕ), x ^ n ∈ W) → x = 1

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.cyclic_nss_of_doubling_growth

      (∀ x ∈ V, size x = 0 → x = 1) →
        (∀ x ∈ V, size x ≤ R) →
          (∀ x ∈ V, x * x ∈ V → c * size x ≤ size (x * x)) → ∀ (x : G), (∀ (n : ℕ), x ^ n ∈ V) → x = 1

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.cyclic_path_sampling

  4 ≤ n →
    ∀ (β : Fin n → Type u_2) [inst : (i : Fin n) → Fintype (β i)] [∀ (i : Fin n), Nonempty (β i)]
      (P : Fin n → ((i : Fin n) → β i) → List V),
      (∀ (i : Fin n), DirectedCycles.DependsOn (DirectedCycles.stepSupport (finRotate n) i) (P i)) →
        (∀ (ω : (i : Fin n) → β i), DirectedCycles.IsPathLoop D fun i => P i ω) →
          ∀ (L T : ℝ),
            0 ≤ L →
              (∀ (i : Fin n) (ω : (i : Fin n) → β i), ↑(P i ω).length ≤ T) →
                (∀ (v : V), (∑ i, DirectedCycles.uniformProbability fun ω => v ∈ P i ω) ≤ L) →
                  L * T ≤ 1 / 48 → ∃ C, n ≤ C.length

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.cyclic_prefix_finish_offsets

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.dense_binomial_multiplier
declarations.type:
∀ {n D L : ℕ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (F : Finset (Fin n → ℕ)),
      (∀ t ∈ F, ∀ (i : Fin n), t i < L) →
        ↑(n * (D - 1)) / ↑L < ↑F.card / ↑L ^ n →
          ∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup V] (v : (Fin n → Fin D) → V) (W : AddSubgroup V),
            (∀ t ∈ F, ∑ a, (∏ i, ↑((t i).choose ↑(a i))) • v a ∈ W) →
              ∃ M,
                0 < M ∧ M ≤ (D ^ n).factorial * L ^ ((n + 2 * n * (D - 1)) * D ^ n) ∧ ∀ (a : Fin n → Fin D), M • v a ∈ W

declarations.type:

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.derivativeNorm_le_escape_of_second

declarations.type:

                      (DirectedCycles.groupDerivative g (DirectedCycles.normalizedConvolution A f k)) h ≤

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.diagonal_internal_choice
declarations.type:

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.directed_cycle_lifting
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Finite G] [Group.IsNilpotent G] (a : G) (S : Set G),
  a ∈ S →
    ∀ (r c n : ℕ),
      Group.rank G ≤ r →
        Group.nilpotencyClass G ≤ c →
          c ≤ n →
            8 * (n + 1) + 4 <
                Nat.card
                  (↥(DirectedCycles.elementClosure a) ⧸
                    (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a).subgroupOf (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) →
              ∀
                (Q :
                  DirectedCycles.Cycle
                    (DirectedCycles.CayleyDigraph (⇑(QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) '' S)))
                (b eta : ℝ),
                0 < b →
                  0 ≤ eta →
                    (∀ (U : Subgroup ↥(DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)),
                        DirectedCycles.LayerCycleLowerBound (↥U) b eta) →
                      ∃ C,
                        C.ClosedUnderGenerator a ∧
                          b / (4 * ↑(DirectedCycles.auxiliaryIndexConstant r c n)) *
                                (↑Q.length / ↑(Nat.card (G ⧸ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a))) ^
                                  (DirectedCycles.auxiliaryIndexExponent r c n + 1) *
                              ↑(Nat.card ↥(DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) ^ (-eta) ≤
                            ↑C.length / ↑(Nat.card G)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.directed_lift_density_recurrence
declarations.type:
∀ (L b T ell h B C I N J eta : ℝ) (kappa : ℕ),
  0 < b →
    0 < ell →
      0 < h →
        0 < B →
          0 < C →
            0 < N →
              0 < J →
                0 ≤ eta →
                  B = I * C →
                    1 ≤ I →
                      I ≤ J * (N / ell) ^ kappa →
                        ell * h / 4 ≤ T →
                          b * T * C ^ (1 - eta) ≤ L →
                            b / (4 * J) * (ell / N) ^ (kappa + 1) * B ^ (-eta) ≤ L / (N * h * B)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.directed_lifting_constants

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.directed_reaches_majority
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [Fintype G] [inst_2 : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
  [inst_4 : MulAction G V] (H : Subgroup G) [H.Normal] [Fintype (Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel (↥H) V))]
  [inst_7 : DecidableEq (Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel (↥H) V))] (D : DirectedCycles.Digraph V),
  (∀ (g : G) (x y : V), D (g • x) (g • y) ↔ D x y) →
    (∀ (x y : V), ∃ g, g • x = y) →
      ∀ (m : ℕ),
        2 ≤ m →
          ∀ (ρ : ℝ),
            1 ≤ ρ →
              (∀ (a : Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel (↥H) V)), {x | Quotient.mk'' x = a}.card = m) →
                (∀ (x y : V), (MulAction.orbitRel (↥H) V) x y → ∃ P, ↑P.length ≤ ρ) →
                  ∀ (x : V),
                    have u := ⌈4 * ρ * Real.log (2 * ↑(Fintype.card V))⌉₊;
                    ∃ a, m < 2 * {y ∈ DirectedCycles.forwardBall D u x | Quotient.mk'' y = a}.card

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.directed_weighted_cut
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [Fintype G] [inst_2 : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
  [inst_4 : MulAction G V] (H : Subgroup G) [H.Normal] [inst_6 : Fintype (Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel (↥H) V))]
  [inst_7 : DecidableEq (Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel (↥H) V))] (D : DirectedCycles.Digraph V),
  (∀ (g : G) (x y : V), D (g • x) (g • y) ↔ D x y) →
    (∀ (x y : V), ∃ g, g • x = y) →
      ∀ (m : ℕ),
        2 ≤ m →
          ∀ (ρ : ℝ),
            1 ≤ ρ →
              (∀ (a : Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel (↥H) V)), {x | Quotient.mk'' x = a}.card = m) →
                (∀ (x y : V), (MulAction.orbitRel (↥H) V) x y → ∃ P, ↑P.length ≤ ρ) →
                  ∀ (S : Finset V),
                    have numerator :=
                      ∑ a, ↑{x ∈ S | Quotient.mk'' x = a}.card * (↑m - ↑{x ∈ S | Quotient.mk'' x = a}.card);
                    numerator / ((↑m - 1) * ρ) ≤ ↑(DirectedCycles.outBoundary D S).card ∧
                      numerator / ((↑m - 1) * ρ) ≤ ↑(DirectedCycles.inBoundary D S).card

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.discrete_radial_norm_le
declarations.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] (exp : E → G) {R ρ : ℝ},

    2 * ρ < R →
      Set.InjOn exp (Metric.ball 0 R) →
        ∀ (v : E), ‖v‖ ≤ ρ → ∀ (N : ℕ), (∀ n ≤ N, exp (↑n • v) ∈ exp '' Metric.closedBall 0 ρ) → ↑N * ‖v‖ ≤ ρ

  Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds x) →
    (∀ (n m : ℕ), 0 < n → 0 < m → dist (a n) (a (n * m)) ≤ K / ↑n) → ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → dist (a n) x ≤ K / ↑n

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.dyadic_curve_addition_bound
declarations.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] (f : ℝ → E) {r C : ℝ},
  0 ≤ C →
    (∀ (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ r → ‖f (t / 2)‖ ≤ 2 / 3 * ‖f t‖) →
      (∀ (s t : ℝ), |s| + |t| ≤ r → ‖f (s + t) - f s - f t‖ ≤ C * (‖f s‖ + ‖f t‖) ^ 2) →
        ∀ {s t : ℝ},
          |s| + |t| ≤ r →
            ∀ (n : ℕ),
              ‖DirectedCycles.dyadicCurve f (s + t) n - DirectedCycles.dyadicCurve f s n -
                    DirectedCycles.dyadicCurve f t n‖ ≤
                C * (‖f s‖ + ‖f t‖) ^ 2 * (8 / 9) ^ n

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.dyadic_curve_increment_bound
declarations.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] (f : ℝ → E) {r C : ℝ},
  0 ≤ C →
    (∀ (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ r → ‖f (t / 2)‖ ≤ 2 / 3 * ‖f t‖) →
      (∀ (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ r → ‖f t - 2 • f (t / 2)‖ ≤ C * ‖f (t / 2)‖ ^ 2) →
        ∀ {t : ℝ},
          |t| ≤ r →
            ∀ (n : ℕ),
              dist (DirectedCycles.dyadicCurve f t n) (DirectedCycles.dyadicCurve f t (n + 1)) ≤
                4 / 9 * C * ‖f t‖ ^ 2 * (8 / 9) ^ n

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.dyadic_curve_limit_add
declarations.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] (f g : ℝ → E) {r C : ℝ},
  0 ≤ C →
    (∀ (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ r → ‖f (t / 2)‖ ≤ 2 / 3 * ‖f t‖) →
      (∀ (s t : ℝ), |s| + |t| ≤ r → ‖f (s + t) - f s - f t‖ ≤ C * (‖f s‖ + ‖f t‖) ^ 2) →
        (∀ (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ r → Filter.Tendsto (DirectedCycles.dyadicCurve f t) Filter.atTop (nhds (g t))) →
          ∀ {s t : ℝ}, |s| + |t| ≤ r → g (s + t) = g s + g t

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.dyadic_curve_norm_bound
declarations.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] (f : ℝ → E) {r : ℝ},
  (∀ (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ r → ‖f (t / 2)‖ ≤ 2 / 3 * ‖f t‖) →
    ∀ {t : ℝ}, |t| ≤ r → ∀ (n : ℕ), ‖f (t / 2 ^ n)‖ ≤ (2 / 3) ^ n * ‖f t‖

  Group.nilpotencyClass G ≤ n →
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (E : Set (G ⧸ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)),
      ∀ W ≤ Submodule.comap ((DirectedCycles.normalAbelianAction (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a) W,
        (∀ g ∈ E,
            DirectedCycles.elementFactorCocycle a g ∈ Submodule.map (DirectedCycles.elementDifferenceRange a).mkQ W) →
          (∀ (z : DirectedCycles.TruncatedGroupRing (G ⧸ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a) (n + 1)),
              m • z ∈
                AddSubgroup.closure
                  (⇑(DirectedCycles.truncatedElement (G ⧸ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a) (n + 1)) '' E)) →

declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Finite G] [Group.IsNilpotent G] (a : G) (r c n : ℕ),
  Group.rank G ≤ r →
    Group.nilpotencyClass G ≤ c →
      c ≤ n →
        ∀ (m : ℕ),
          0 < m →
            ∀ (E : Set (G ⧸ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) (C : Subgroup ↥(DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)),
              ∀ W ≤ Submodule.comap ((DirectedCycles.normalAbelianAction (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a) W,
                W.toAddSubgroup ≤ Subgroup.toAddSubgroup (Subgroup.map Abelianization.of C) →
                  (∀ g ∈ E,
                      DirectedCycles.elementFactorCocycle a g ∈
                        Submodule.map (DirectedCycles.elementDifferenceRange a).mkQ W) →
                    (∀ (z : DirectedCycles.TruncatedGroupRing (G ⧸ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a) (n + 1)),
                        m • z ∈
                          AddSubgroup.closure
                            (⇑(DirectedCycles.truncatedElement (G ⧸ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a) (n + 1)) '' E)) →
                      C.index ≤
                        m ^
                          ((n + 1) *
                            ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (c / 2), (i + 1) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range c, r ^ (j + 1)) ^ (i + 1))

  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [inst_8 : ChartedSpace E H] [inst_9 : LieGroup (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (↑⊤) H]
  (U : Ultrafilter ι) (G : ι → Type u_4) [(i : ι) → Fintype (G i)]
  (L : (i : ι) → DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra (G i)) (hd : ∀ (i : ι), (L i).DivisionClosed)
  (hr : ∀ (i : ι), (L i).Reversible) (A : (i : ι) → Finset (G i)) {Ka : ℕ},
  (∀ (i : ι), DirectedCycles.IsLocalFiniteApproximateGroup (L i) Ka (A i)) →
    ∀
      (π :
        DirectedCycles.LocalGroupHom (DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L)
          (DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.ofGroup H))
      (V : Set H),
      IsCompact V →
        (∀ (x : H), (∀ (n : ℕ), x ^ n ∈ V) → x = 1) →
          (∀ z ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(A i), π.toFun z ∈ V) →
            ∀ (U₀ : Set H),
              IsOpen U₀ →
                1 ∈ U₀ →
                  (π.toFun ⁻¹' U₀ ⊆ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(A i)) →
                    (∀ (F O : Set H),
                        IsCompact F →
                          IsOpen O →
                            F ⊆ O →
                              O ⊆ U₀ →
                                ∃ B,
                                  (π.toFun ⁻¹' F ⊆ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(B i)) ∧
                                    (DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(B i)) ⊆ π.toFun ⁻¹' O) →
                      ∀ (P : (i : ι) → Finset (G i)) {τ : ℝ},
                        0 < τ →
                          (∀ (i : ι),
                              (L i).CentralLocalSet ↑(P i) {x | (L i).escapeNorm (↑(A i)) x < 1 / 1001}
                                {x | (L i).escapeNorm (↑(A i)) x < τ}) →
                            ∀ {Q T W : Set H} (hQ : DirectedCycles.LocalNormalSet Q T) (hW1 : 1 ∈ W) (hWi : W⁻¹ = W)
                              (hW6 : W ^ 6 ⊆ T),
                              IsOpen W →
                                ∀ [T2Space (hQ.WindowQuotient hW1 hWi hW6)],
                                  (π.toFun '' DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(P i)) = Q →
                                    ∀ (Vq : Set (hQ.WindowQuotient hW1 hWi hW6)) (Z : Set H),
                                      IsCompact Z → 1 ∈ interior Z → Z ⊆ W → Z ⊆ U₀ → ⋯ → ⋯

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.lie_prescribed_escape_controlled_central_model
declarations.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} {E : Type u_3} [inst : Group H] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace H] [IsTopologicalGroup H]
  [T2Space H] [inst_4 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_5 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_6 : CompleteSpace E]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [inst_8 : ChartedSpace E H] [inst_9 : LieGroup (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (↑⊤) H]
  (U : Ultrafilter ι) (G : ι → Type u_4) [(i : ι) → Fintype (G i)]
  (L : (i : ι) → DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra (G i)) (hd : ∀ (i : ι), (L i).DivisionClosed)
  (hr : ∀ (i : ι), (L i).Reversible) (A : (i : ι) → Finset (G i)) {Ka : ℕ},
  (∀ (i : ι), DirectedCycles.IsLocalFiniteApproximateGroup (L i) Ka (A i)) →
    (∀ (i : ι), (L i).IsNSS ↑(A i)) →
      ∀ (u : (i : ι) → G i) (Nu : ι → ℕ) (pu : (i : ι) → (L i).PowerSegment (u i) (2 * Nu i)),
        (∀ (i : ι), 2 ≤ Nu i) →
          (∀ (i : ι), ∀ n < Nu i, (pu i).power n ∈ A i) →
            (∀ (i : ι), (pu i).power (Nu i) ∉ A i) →
              (∀ (i : ι), u i ≠ (L i).one) →
                (∀ (i : ι), (L i).escapeNorm (↑(A i)) (u i) = 1 / ↑(Nu i)) →
                  (∀ (i : ι),
                      ∀ x ∈ A i, x ≠ (L i).one → (L i).escapeNorm (↑(A i)) (u i) ≤ (L i).escapeNorm (↑(A i)) x) →
                    (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, n < Nu i) →
                      ∀
                        (π :
                          DirectedCycles.LocalGroupHom (DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L)
                            (DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.ofGroup H))
                        {Ra ra : ℝ},
                        0 < ra →
                          1001 / 1000 * ra < Ra →
                            Set.InjOn DirectedCycles.lieExponential (Metric.ball 0 Ra) →
                              (∀ z ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(A i),
                                  π.toFun z ∈ DirectedCycles.lieExponential '' Metric.closedBall 0 (1001 / 1000 * ra)) →
                                (∀ (z : DirectedCycles.LocalUltraproduct (↑U) G),
                                    π.toFun z ∈ DirectedCycles.lieExponential '' Metric.ball 0 ra →
                                      z ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(A i)) →
                                  ∀ (φ : ℝ → H),
                                    φ 0 = 1 →
                                      ContinuousAt φ 0 →
                                        (∀ (s t : ℝ), φ (s + t) = φ s * φ t) →
                                          (∀ (t : ℝ),
                                              |t| ≤ 1 →
                                                φ t =
                                                  π.toFun
                                                    (DirectedCycles.localScaledPower U G L u Nu (fun i => 2 * Nu i) pu
                                                      t)) →
                                            ∀ (V : Set H),
                                              IsCompact V →
                                                (∀ (x : H), (∀ (n : ℕ), x ^ n ∈ V) → x = 1) →
                                                  (∀ z ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(A i),
                                                      π.toFun z ∈ V) →
                                                    ∀ (U₀ : Set H), IsOpen U₀ → ⋯

declarations.type:

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.localStrongFiniteApproximate_eventually
declarations.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (U : Ultrafilter ι) (G : ι → Type u_2) (L : (i : ι) → DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra (G i)) {K : ℕ}
  (A : (i : ι) → Finset (G i)) (S : (i : ι) → Set (G i)),
  DirectedCycles.IsLocalApproximateSet (DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L) K
      (DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(A i)) →
    (∀ s ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G S,
        (DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L).inv s ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G S) →
      (DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L).AllProductsDefined
          ((DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L).conjugates (DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G S)
            ((DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L).wordPower (DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(A i))
              4))
          (1000 * K ^ 3) →
        ((DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L).wordPower
              ((DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L).conjugates (DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G S)
                ((DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L).wordPower
                  (DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(A i)) 4))
              (1000 * K ^ 3) ⊆
            DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(A i)) →
          (∀ (x : DirectedCycles.LocalUltraproduct (↑U) G),
              (∀ (j : ℕ),
                  1 ≤ j →
                    j ≤ 1000 →
                      (DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L).PowerIn
                        ((DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L).wordPower
                          (DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(A i)) 100)
                        x j) →
                x ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(A i)) →
            (∀ (x : DirectedCycles.LocalUltraproduct (↑U) G),
                (∀ (j : ℕ),
                    1 ≤ j →
                      j ≤ 1000000 * K ^ 3 →
                        (DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L).PowerIn
                          (DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(A i)) x j) →
                  x ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G S) →
              ∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, DirectedCycles.IsStrongLocalFiniteApproximateGroup (L i) K (A i)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.localUltra_escapeNorm_product_le

  (A : (i : ι) → Set (G i)),
  (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, (L i).one ∈ A i) →
    ∀ (B : ℝ),

          ∀ (l : List (G i)) (x : G i),
            (L i).Product l x → (L i).escapeNorm (A i) x ≤ B * (List.map ((L i).escapeNorm (A i)) l).sum) →

                (DirectedCycles.localUltraMk (↑U) G x) ≤
              B *

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.local_central_correction_contradiction
declarations.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (U : Ultrafilter ι) (G : ι → Type u_2) (L : (i : ι) → DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra (G i))
  {H : Type u_3} {E : Type u_4} [inst : Group H] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace H] [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_3 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_4 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_5 : ChartedSpace E H]
  [inst_6 : LieGroup (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (↑⊤) H],
  (∀ (i : ι), (L i).DivisionClosed) →
    (∀ (i : ι), (L i).Reversible) →
      ∀ (B : (i : ι) → Finset (G i)) (g u : (i : ι) → G i) (N₁ M₁ N₀ M₀ : ι → ℕ)
        (p : (i : ι) → (L i).PowerSegment (g i) (M₁ i)) (q : (i : ι) → (L i).PowerSegment (u i) (M₀ i)),
        (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, n < N₁ i) →
          (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, n < N₀ i) →
            (∀ (i : ι), 2 * N₁ i ≤ M₁ i) →
              (∀ (i : ι), 4 * N₀ i ≤ M₀ i) →
                (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, ∀ x ∈ B i, (L i).inv x ∈ B i) →
                  (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, ∀ n < N₁ i, (p i).power n ∈ B i) →
                    (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, ∀ n < N₀ i, (q i).power n ∈ B i) →
                      ∀
                        (π :
                          DirectedCycles.LocalGroupHom (DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L)
                            (DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.ofGroup H))
                        (V : Set H),
                        (∀ (x : H), (∀ (n : ℕ), x ^ n ∈ V) → x = 1) →
                          (∀ z ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(B i), π.toFun z ∈ V) →
                            ∀ (φ ψ : ℝ → H),
                              (∀ (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ 1 → φ t = π.toFun (DirectedCycles.localScaledPower U G L g N₁ M₁ p t)) →
                                (∀ (t : ℝ),
                                    |t| ≤ 1 → ψ t = π.toFun (DirectedCycles.localScaledPower U G L u N₀ M₀ q t)) →
                                  (∀ (s t : ℝ), ψ (s + t) = ψ s * ψ t) →
                                    ∀ {r δ t t' : ℝ},
                                      0 < r →
                                        0 < δ →
                                          ∀ (X : E),
                                            ‖X‖ ≤ 1001 / 1000 * r →
                                              (∀ (s : ℝ), φ s = DirectedCycles.lieExponential ((t * s) • X)) →
                                                (∀ (s : ℝ), ψ s = DirectedCycles.lieExponential ((t' * s) • X)) →
                                                  |t| ≤ 11 / 10 * δ →
                                                    9 / 10 * δ ≤ t' →
                                                      t' ≤ 11 / 10 * δ →
                                                        (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, ↑(N₁ i) ≤ 11 / 10 * ↑(N₀ i)) →
                                                          (∀ (z : DirectedCycles.LocalUltraproduct (↑U) G),
                                                              π.toFun z ∈
                                                                  DirectedCycles.lieExponential ''
                                                                    Metric.ball 0 (δ * r) →
                                                                z ∈
                                                                  DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(B i)) →
                                                            (∀ (i : ι), 0 < N₀ i) →
                                                              (∀ (i : ι), 0 < N₁ i) →
                                                                ∀ (C P : (i : ι) → Set (G i))
                                                                  (D : (i : ι) → (L i).CentralQuotientData (P i)), ⋯

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.local_central_generator_escape_bound
declarations.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Group H] (U : Ultrafilter ι) (G : ι → Type u_3)
  (L : (i : ι) → DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra (G i)),
  (∀ (i : ι), (L i).DivisionClosed) →

          (∀ (i : ι), B i ⊆ A i) →
            (∀ (i : ι), ∀ x ∈ A i, (L i).inv x ∈ A i) →
              ∀ (u : (i : ι) → G i) (N : ι → ℕ) (p : (i : ι) → (L i).PowerSegment (u i) (2 * N i)),
                (∀ (i : ι), 0 < N i) →
                  (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, n < N i) →
                    (∀ (i : ι), ∀ n < N i, (p i).power n ∈ A i) →
                      (∀ (i : ι), (p i).power (N i) ∉ A i) →
                        ∀
                          (π :
                            DirectedCycles.LocalGroupHom (DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L)
                              (DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.ofGroup H))
                          (V : Set H),
                          (∀ (x : H), (∀ (n : ℕ), x ^ n ∈ V) → x = 1) →
                            (∀ z ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G A, π.toFun z ∈ V) →

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.local_central_progression_family
declarations.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (F : Filter ι) (G : ι → Type u_2) [(i : ι) → Fintype (G i)]
  (L : (i : ι) → DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra (G i)),
  (∀ (i : ι), (L i).DivisionClosed) →
    (∀ (i : ι), (L i).Reversible) →
      ∀ (A B : (i : ι) → Finset (G i)) (P : (i : ι) → Set (G i)) (D : (i : ι) → (L i).CentralQuotientData (P i))
        {K J Jq r c : ℕ},
        1 ≤ J →
          1 ≤ Jq →
            ∀ {C C₀ : ℝ},
              0 ≤ C →
                0 ≤ C₀ →
                  (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in F, DirectedCycles.IsStrongLocalFiniteApproximateGroup (L i) K (B i)) →
                    (∀ (i : ι), ↑(B i) ⊆ ↑(A i)) →
                      (∀ (i : ι), ↑(B i) ⊆ (D i).small) →
                        (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in F,
                            ∀ y ∈ (D i).finiteImage (B i),
                              ∃ x,
                                ↑x ∈ B i ∧
                                  (D i).project x = y ∧
                                    (L i).escapeNorm ↑(B i) ↑x ≤
                                      C * (D i).algebra.escapeNorm (↑((D i).finiteImage (B i))) y) →
                          (∀ (i : ι), ∀ p ∈ P i, ∀ b ∈ B i, (L i).Commute p b) →
                            ∀ (u : (i : ι) → G i) (n : ι → ℕ) (p : (i : ι) → (L i).PowerSegment (u i) (2 * n i)),
                              (∀ (i : ι), 2 ≤ n i) →
                                (∀ (i : ι), u i ≠ (L i).one) →
                                  (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in F, (L i).escapeNorm (↑(B i)) (u i) ≤ C₀ / (↑(n i) + 1)) →
                                    (∀ (i : ι), (L i).IsNSS ↑(A i)) →
                                      (∀ (i : ι), ∀ x ∈ A i, ∀ y ∈ A i, (L i).Defined x y) →
                                        (∀ (i : ι), ∀ m < n i, (p i).power m ∈ A i) →
                                          (∀ (i : ι) (k : ℤ), k.natAbs < n i → (p i).signedPower k ∈ P i) →
                                            (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in F,
                                                (A i).card ≤ J * ((D i).finiteImage (B i)).card * (2 * n i - 1)) →
                                              ∀ (g : (i : ι) → Fin r → (D i).Carrier) (N : ι → Fin r → ℕ),
                                                (∀ (j : Fin r), Filter.Tendsto (fun i => N i j) F Filter.atTop) →
                                                  Filter.Tendsto n F Filter.atTop →
                                                    (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in F,
                                                        ∃ (hq :
                                                          (D i).algebra.SignedWordsIn (g i) (N i)
                                                            ↑((D i).finiteImage (B i))),
                                                          Function.Injective ((D i).algebra.orderedGrid hq) ∧
                                                            (∀ (x : (D i).Carrier),
                                                                (D i).algebra.GeneratorCommutators (Set.range (g i)) c
                                                                    x →
                                                                  x = (D i).algebra.one) ∧
                                                              ((D i).finiteImage (B i)).card ≤
                                                                Jq * ∏ j, (2 * N i j + 1)) →
                                                      ∃ T M,
                                                        3 ≤ T ∧
                                                          1 ≤ M ∧
                                                            (∀ (j : Fin (r + 1)),
                                                                Filter.Tendsto
                                                                  (fun i => Fin.lastCases (n i) (N i) j / T) F
                                                                  Filter.atTop) ∧
                                                              ∀ᶠ (i : ι) in F,
                                                                ∃ W,
                                                                  (W.lengths = fun j =>
                                                                      Fin.lastCases (n i) (N i) j / T) ∧
                                                                    (A i).card ≤ M * ∏ j, (2 * W.lengths j + 1)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.local_central_progression_family_from_windows

                    (π :

                        (DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.ofGroup H))

                          ∀ {Q T W : Set H} (hQ : DirectedCycles.LocalNormalSet Q T) (hW1 : 1 ∈ W) (hWi : W⁻¹ = W)

                                ∃ J η,

                                    0 < η ∧
                                      ∃ D B,
                                        (∀ (i : ι),
                                            DirectedCycles.IsLocalFiniteApproximateGroup (L i) J (B i) ∧
                                              η * ↑(A i).card ≤ ↑(B i).card ∧
                                                (∀ n ≤ 200, (L i).wordPower (↑(B i)) n ⊆ (D i).small) ∧
                                                  DirectedCycles.IsLocalFiniteApproximateGroup (D i).algebra J
                                                      ((D i).finiteImage (B i)) ∧
                                                    η * ↑(A i).card ≤ ↑((D i).finiteImage (B i)).card * ↑(P i).card) ∧
                                          ∃ F,
                                            ∀
                                              (a :

                                                      L (fun i => ↑(P i)) D).small),
                                              F.toFun
                                                    ((DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.ultraproduct
                                                          U G L (fun i => ↑(P i)) D).project
                                                      a) =

declarations.type:

                (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, ∀ x ∈ A i, (L i).inv x ∈ A i) →

                            (π :

                                (DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.ofGroup H))

        DifferentiableAt ℝ μ (0, 0) →

declarations.type:

        (p : (i : ι) → (L i).PowerSegment (g i) (M₁ i)) (q : (i : ι) → (L i).PowerSegment (u i) (M₀ i)),
        (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, n < N₁ i) →
          (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, n < N₀ i) →
            (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, 2 * N₁ i ≤ M₁ i) →
              (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, 4 * N₀ i ≤ M₀ i) →
                (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, ∀ x ∈ B i, (L i).inv x ∈ B i) →
                  (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, ∀ n < N₁ i, (p i).power n ∈ B i) →
                    (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, ∀ n < N₀ i, (q i).power n ∈ B i) →
                      ∀
                        (π :
                          DirectedCycles.LocalGroupHom (DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L)
                            (DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.ofGroup H))
                        (V : Set H),
                        (∀ (x : H), (∀ (n : ℕ), x ^ n ∈ V) → x = 1) →
                          (∀ z ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G B, π.toFun z ∈ V) →
                            ∀ (φ ψ : ℝ → H),
                              (∀ (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ 1 → φ t = π.toFun (DirectedCycles.localScaledPower U G L g N₁ M₁ p t)) →
                                (∀ (t : ℝ),
                                    |t| ≤ 1 → ψ t = π.toFun (DirectedCycles.localScaledPower U G L u N₀ M₀ q t)) →
                                  (∀ (s t : ℝ), ψ (s + t) = ψ s * ψ t) →
                                    ∀ {r δ t t' : ℝ},
                                      0 < r →
                                        0 < δ →
                                          ∀ (X : E),
                                            ‖X‖ ≤ 1001 / 1000 * r →
                                              (∀ (s : ℝ), φ s = DirectedCycles.lieExponential ((t * s) • X)) →
                                                (∀ (s : ℝ), ψ s = DirectedCycles.lieExponential ((t' * s) • X)) →
                                                  (∀ (z : DirectedCycles.LocalUltraproduct (↑U) G),
                                                      π.toFun z ∈
                                                          DirectedCycles.lieExponential '' Metric.ball 0 (δ * r) →
                                                        z ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G B) →
                                                    ∀ (m : ι → ℤ) (s : (i : ι) → ℕ → G i),
                                                      (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, (m i).natAbs * N₁ i ≤ 2 * N₀ i) →

                                                                ((q i).signedPower (-m i * ↑n)) (s i n)) →
                                                          (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, ∀ n ≤ N₁ i, ⋯) →
                                                            ∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, ∀ n ≤ N₁ i, s i n ∈ B i

      (fun x => μ (0, x)) =ᶠ[nhds 0] id →
        ∀ (f : ℝ → E),
          f 0 = 0 →
            ContinuousAt f 0 →

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.local_multiplicative_curve_unique

      f 0 = 0 →
        g 0 = 0 →
          ∀ {v : E},
            HasDerivAt f v 0 →
              HasDerivAt g v 0 →
                ∀ {r s : ℝ},
                  0 < r →

                          ∀ (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ r → |t| ≤ s → f t = g t

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.local_nested_escape_ratio
declarations.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (U : Ultrafilter ι) (G : ι → Type u_2) (L : (i : ι) → DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra (G i))
  {H : Type u_3} {E : Type u_4} [inst : Group H] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace H] [IsTopologicalGroup H] [T2Space H]
  [inst_4 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_5 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_6 : CompleteSpace E] [inst_7 : ChartedSpace E H]
  [hLie : LieGroup (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (↑⊤) H],
  (∀ (i : ι), (L i).DivisionClosed) →
    (∀ (i : ι), (L i).Reversible) →
      ∀ (A B : (i : ι) → Set (G i)) (u : (i : ι) → G i) (N M K J : ι → ℕ) (p : (i : ι) → (L i).PowerSegment (u i) (M i))
        (q : (i : ι) → (L i).PowerSegment (u i) (J i)),
        (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, B i ⊆ A i) →
          (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, n < N i) →
            (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, 2 * N i ≤ M i) →
              (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, 2 * K i ≤ J i) →
                (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, ∀ x ∈ A i, (L i).inv x ∈ A i) →
                  (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, ∀ x ∈ B i, (L i).inv x ∈ B i) →
                    (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, ∀ n < N i, (p i).power n ∈ A i) →
                      (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, ∀ n < K i, (q i).power n ∈ B i) →
                        (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, (p i).power (N i) ∉ A i) →
                          (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, (q i).power (K i) ∉ B i) →
                            ∀
                              (π :
                                DirectedCycles.LocalGroupHom (DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L)
                                  (DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.ofGroup H))
                              (V : Set H),
                              IsCompact V →
                                (∀ (x : H), (∀ (n : ℕ), x ^ n ∈ V) → x = 1) →
                                  (∀ z ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G A, π.toFun z ∈ V) →
                                    ∀ {R r δ : ℝ},
                                      0 < r →
                                        0 < δ →
                                          δ ≤ 1 →
                                            1001 / 1000 * r < R →
                                              Set.InjOn DirectedCycles.lieExponential (Metric.ball 0 R) →
                                                (∀ z ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G A,
                                                    π.toFun z ∈
                                                      DirectedCycles.lieExponential ''
                                                        Metric.closedBall 0 (1001 / 1000 * r)) →
                                                  (∀ (z : DirectedCycles.LocalUltraproduct (↑U) G),
                                                      π.toFun z ∈ DirectedCycles.lieExponential '' Metric.ball 0 r →
                                                        z ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G A) →
                                                    (∀ z ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G B,
                                                        π.toFun z ∈
                                                          DirectedCycles.lieExponential '' Metric.closedBall 0 ⋯) →
                                                      (∀ (z : DirectedCycles.LocalUltraproduct (↑U) G),
                                                          π.toFun z ∈
                                                              DirectedCycles.lieExponential '' Metric.ball 0 (δ * r) →
                                                            z ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G B) →
                                                        ∃ t ∈ Set.Ioo (99 / 100 * δ) (101 / 100 * δ),
                                                          Filter.Tendsto (fun i => ↑(K i) / ↑(N i)) (↑U) (nhds t) ∧
                                                            ∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, ⋯

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.local_nss_approximate_quotient
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G) (hd : L.DivisionClosed) (hr : L.Reversible) {A B : Finset G}
  {K : ℕ},
  L.one ∈ A →
    (∀ x ∈ A, L.inv x ∈ A) →
      L.AllProductsDefined (↑A) 200 →
        ∀ (C : ℝ),
          (∀ x ∈ A,
              ∀ y ∈ A,
                ∀ (z : G), L.mulRel x y z → L.escapeNorm (↑A) z ≤ C * (L.escapeNorm (↑A) x + L.escapeNorm (↑A) y)) →
            (∀ (x : G), (∀ (j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → j ≤ 1000 → L.PowerIn (L.wordPower (↑A) 100) x j) → x ∈ A) →
              DirectedCycles.IsLocalFiniteApproximateGroup L K B →
                L.wordPower (↑B) 200 ⊆ ↑A →
                  have H := {x | L.escapeNorm (↑A) x = 0};
                  ∃ (W : L.NormalSubgroupWindow H (L.setMul H ↑A)),
                    DirectedCycles.IsLocalFiniteApproximateGroup (W.congruence hd ⋯).algebra K (W.finiteImage hd ⋯ B) ∧
                      (W.congruence hd ⋯).algebra.IsNSS Set.univ ∧
                        (W.congruence hd ⋯).algebra.DivisionClosed ∧
                          (W.congruence hd ⋯).algebra.Reversible ∧
                            B.card ≤ (W.finiteImage hd ⋯ B).card * (DirectedCycles.localZeroEscapeFinset L A).card

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.local_nss_neighbourhood_of_differentiable_coordinates
declarations.type:

  (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G) (chart : G → E) (unchart : E → G),
  ∀ V ∈ nhds L.one,
    ContinuousAt chart L.one →
      ContinuousAt unchart 0 →
        chart L.one = 0 →
          unchart 0 = L.one →
            (∀ x ∈ V, unchart (chart x) = x) →
              (fun x => chart (unchart x)) =ᶠ[nhds 0] id →
                ∀ (m : G × G → G),
                  (∀ᶠ (p : G × G) in nhds (L.one, L.one), L.mulRel p.1 p.2 (m p)) →
                    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun p => chart (m (unchart p.1, unchart p.2))) (0, 0) →
                      ∃ W ∈ nhds L.one,
                        L.IsNSS W ∧
                          (∀ (x : G) (p : L.PowerSequence x), (∀ (n : ℕ), p.power n ∈ W) → x = L.one) ∧
                            ∀ U ∈ nhds L.one, ∃ M, 1 ≤ M ∧ ∀ (x : G), (∀ n ≤ M, L.PowerIn W x n) → x ∈ U

declarations.type:

  (Q : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra H) (a : OpenPartialHomeomorph E H),

    ↑a 0 = Q.one →
      ∀ (μ : E × E → E),
        μ (0, 0) = 0 →
          ContinuousAt μ (0, 0) →
            (∀ᶠ (p : E × E) in nhds (0, 0), Q.mulRel (↑a p.1) (↑a p.2) (↑a (μ p))) →
              ∀ (f : ℝ → H),
                f 0 = Q.one →
                  ContinuousAt f 0 →
                    ∀ {r : ℝ},
                      0 < r →
                        (∀ (s t : ℝ), |s| + |t| ≤ r → Q.mulRel (f s) (f t) (f (s + t))) →
                          have g := fun t => ↑a.symm (f t);
                          g 0 = 0 ∧
                            ContinuousAt g 0 ∧ ∃ s, 0 < s ∧ ∀ (u v : ℝ), |u| + |v| ≤ s → g (u + v) = μ (g u, g v)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.measurable_optimal_escape_bump
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace G]
  [OpensMeasurableSpace G] {A : Set G},
  1 ∈ A →
    A⁻¹ = A →
      IsOpen A →
        (∃ b, b ∉ A) →
          ∀ {ε : ℝ},
            0 < ε →
              ∃ r b,
                ε ≤ r ∧
                  b ∉ A ∧
                    DirectedCycles.regularizedEscapeDistance A ε b < 2 * r ∧
                      (∀ g ∉ A, r ≤ DirectedCycles.regularizedEscapeDistance A ε g) ∧
                        ∃ φ,
                          Measurable φ ∧
                            (∀ (x : G), 0 ≤ φ x ∧ φ x ≤ 1) ∧
                              (∀ x ∈ A, φ x = 1) ∧
                                (∀ x ∉ A ^ 2, φ x = 0) ∧
                                  ∀ (g x : G), |φ (g⁻¹ * x) - φ x| ≤ DirectedCycles.regularizedEscapeDistance A ε g / r

    1 ∈ U →
      U⁻¹ = U →

          0 < P →

      ∀ (C : ℕ),
        (∀ (x : G), (∀ (j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → j ≤ C → x ^ j ∈ A ^ 2) → x ∈ A) →
          ∀ {B D : ℝ},
            0 < B →

                (∀ (l : List G),
                    DirectedCycles.escapeNorm A l.prod ≤ B * (List.map (DirectedCycles.escapeNorm A) l).sum) →

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.nilpotent_cycle_theorem
declarations.type:

          Group.rank G ≤ r →
            Group.nilpotencyClass G ≤ c →
              (Nontrivial G → ∀ (S : Set G), Subgroup.closure S = ⊤ → ∃ C, b * ↑(Nat.card G) ^ (1 - eps) ≤ ↑C.length) ∧
                ∀ (T : ℕ),
                  1 ≤ T →
                    ∀ (S : ZMod T → Set G),
                      (∀ (z : ZMod T), (S z).Nonempty) →
                        DirectedCycles.StronglyConnected (DirectedCycles.CyclicLayerDigraph S) →
