declarations.name: DirectedCycles.nilpotent_large_round_cycle
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Finite G] [Group.IsNilpotent G] {T : ℕ} [NeZero T] (S : ZMod T → Set G)
  (xs : List G),
  xs.length = T →
    DirectedCycles.LayerWord S 0 xs →
      ∀ (r c n : ℕ),
        Group.rank G ≤ r →
          Group.nilpotencyClass G ≤ c →
            c ≤ n →
              8 * (n + 1) + 4 <
                  Nat.card
                    (↥(DirectedCycles.elementClosure xs.prod) ⧸
                      (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators xs.prod).subgroupOf (DirectedCycles.elementClosure xs.prod)) →
                DirectedCycles.elementClosure xs.prod ≠ ⊤ →
                  ∀ (bq bl eps : ℝ),
                    0 < bq →
                      0 < bl →
                        0 ≤ eps →
                          DirectedCycles.CayleySpanningBound (G ⧸ DirectedCycles.elementClosure xs.prod) (n + 1) bq
                              (eps / (↑(DirectedCycles.auxiliaryIndexExponent r c n) + 1)) →
                            DirectedCycles.LayerSpanningBound (↥(DirectedCycles.elementCommutators xs.prod)) (n + 1) bl
                                eps →
                              (∀ (U : Subgroup ↥(DirectedCycles.elementCommutators xs.prod)),
                                  DirectedCycles.LayerCycleLowerBound (↥U) bl eps) →
                                DirectedCycles.StronglyConnected (DirectedCycles.CyclicLayerDigraph S) →
                                  have k := DirectedCycles.auxiliaryIndexExponent r c n + 1;
                                  have b :=
                                    min (bl / (4 * ↑(DirectedCycles.auxiliaryIndexConstant r c n)) * bq ^ k)
                                      (bl / 4 * bq);
                                  ∃ L,
                                    b * ↑T * ↑(Nat.card G) ^ (1 - eps) ≤ ↑L.length ∧
                                      (DirectedCycles.AbovePrimeCutoff G (n + 1) →
                                        ∀ (z : ZMod T), DirectedCycles.SpansTruncation (n + 1) (L.layerCoordinates z))

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.normal_closure_of_one_element
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Finite G] [Group.IsNilpotent G] (a : G),
  a ≠ 1 →
    ∀ (r c : ℕ),
      Group.rank G ≤ r →
        Group.nilpotencyClass G ≤ c →
          let B := DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a;
          have K := DirectedCycles.elementClosure a;
          have h := Nat.card (↥K ⧸ B.subgroupOf K);
          B.Normal ∧
            K.Normal ∧
              K = Subgroup.normalClosure {a} ∧
                ⁅⊤, K⁆ = B ∧
                  IsCyclic (↥K ⧸ B.subgroupOf K) ∧
                    2 ≤ h ∧
                      Group.nilpotencyClass ↥B ≤ c / 2 ∧
                        Nat.card ↥K ≤ h ^ (c * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range c, r ^ (i + 1)) ∧ (K = ⊤ → Subgroup.zpowers a = ⊤)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.normal_core_nilpotent_quotient_bounds

  [Group.IsNilpotent (↥U ⧸ H.subgroupOf U)],
  U ≤ Subgroup.normalizer ↑H →
    ∀ (r c : ℕ),
      Group.rank (↥U ⧸ H.subgroupOf U) ≤ r →
        Group.nilpotencyClass (↥U ⧸ H.subgroupOf U) ≤ c →
          Group.IsNilpotent (↥U.normalCore ⧸ Subgroup.comap U.normalCore.subtype H.normalCore) ∧
            Group.rank (↥U.normalCore ⧸ Subgroup.comap U.normalCore.subtype H.normalCore) ≤
                ∑ i ∈ Finset.range c, ((r + 1) ^ U.index) ^ (i + 1) ∧
              Group.nilpotencyClass (↥U.normalCore ⧸ Subgroup.comap U.normalCore.subtype H.normalCore) ≤ c

  (A : (i : ι) → Finset (G i)) (H : Subgroup (DirectedCycles.GroupUltraproduct (↑u) G)),
  (DirectedCycles.ultraSet (↑u) G fun i => ↑(A i)) ⊆ ↑H →
    ∀ (T : Set ↥H),
      (T = ⇑H.subtype ⁻¹' DirectedCycles.ultraSet (↑u) G fun i => ↑(A i)) →
        ∀ (M : DirectedCycles.InternalLocallyCompactGroupModel (↥H) T (DirectedCycles.IsInternalFiniteIn u G H))
          [TotallyDisconnectedSpace M.carrier],
          ∃ k, 1 ≤ k ∧ ∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑u, ∃ P, P.carrier ⊆ ↑(A i) ∧ Nat.card ↑↑(A i) ≤ k * Nat.card ↑P.carrier

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.reachWithin_iff_simplePath
declarations.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} {D : DirectedCycles.Digraph V} {t : ℕ} {x y : V},

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.reachWithin_invariant
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : MulAction G V] (D : DirectedCycles.Digraph V),
  (∀ (g : G) (x y : V), D (g • x) (g • y) ↔ D x y) →
    ∀ (g : G) (t : ℕ) (x y : V), DirectedCycles.ReachWithin D t (g • x) (g • y) ↔ DirectedCycles.ReachWithin D t x y

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.reachable_card_eq
declarations.type:

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.reachable_leaving_set
declarations.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} {D : DirectedCycles.Digraph V} (U : Set V) {x y : V},

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.reachable_map
declarations.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} {D : DirectedCycles.Digraph V} {E : DirectedCycles.Digraph W} (f : V → W),
  (∀ (x y : V), D x y → E (f x) (f y)) →
    ∀ {x y : V}, DirectedCycles.Reachable D x y → DirectedCycles.Reachable E (f x) (f y)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.reachable_mem_relationBall
declarations.type:

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.reaches_majority_of_expansion
declarations.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq V] [inst_3 : DecidableEq W]
  (D : DirectedCycles.Digraph V) (π : V → W) (m : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ),
  1 ≤ ρ →
    (∀ (S : Finset V),
        (∀ (a : W), 2 * {x ∈ S | π x = a}.card ≤ m) → ↑S.card / (2 * ρ) ≤ ↑(DirectedCycles.outBoundary D S).card) →
      ∀ (x : V),
        have u := ⌈4 * ρ * Real.log (2 * ↑(Fintype.card V))⌉₊;
        ∃ a, m < 2 * {y ∈ DirectedCycles.forwardBall D u x | π y = a}.card

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.real_additive_curve_nat_mul
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (f : ℝ → G),
  f 0 = 1 → (∀ (s t : ℝ), f (s + t) = f s * f t) → ∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ), f (↑n * t) = f t ^ n

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.real_curve_int_mul
declarations.type:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Group H] (φ : ℝ → H),
  φ 0 = 1 → (∀ (s t : ℝ), φ (s + t) = φ s * φ t) → ∀ (t : ℝ) (m : ℤ), φ (↑m * t) = φ t ^ m

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.real_curve_neg
declarations.type:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Group H] (φ : ℝ → H),
  φ 0 = 1 → (∀ (s t : ℝ), φ (s + t) = φ s * φ t) → ∀ (t : ℝ), φ (-t) = (φ t)⁻¹

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.real_curve_sub
declarations.type:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : Group H] (φ : ℝ → H),
  φ 0 = 1 → (∀ (s t : ℝ), φ (s + t) = φ s * φ t) → ∀ (s t : ℝ), φ (s - t) = φ s * (φ t)⁻¹

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.regular_bipartite_matching
declarations.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype A] [inst_1 : Fintype B] (E : A → B → Prop) [inst_2 : DecidableRel E]
  (d : ℕ),
  0 < d →
    Fintype.card A = Fintype.card B →
      (∀ (a : A), (Finset.filter (E a) Finset.univ).card = d) →
        (∀ (b : B), {a | E a b}.card = d) → ∃ f, ∀ (a : A), E a (f a)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.regular_directed_euler_sequence
declarations.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype V] (D : DirectedCycles.Digraph V),
  DirectedCycles.StronglyConnected D →
    ∀ (d : ℕ),
      0 < d →
        0 < Fintype.card V →
          (∀ (v : V), (Finset.filter (D v) Finset.univ).card = d) →
            (∀ (v : V), {u | D u v}.card = d) →
              ∃ N A,
                N = Fintype.card V * d ∧
                  ∃ (hA : ∀ (i : Fin N), D (A i) (A ((finRotate N) i))),
                    Function.Bijective fun i => ⟨(A i, A ((finRotate N) i)), ⋯⟩

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.regularizedEscapeDistance_inv
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] {A : Set G},
  A⁻¹ = A →

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.regularizedEscapeDistance_le
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] {A : Set G},

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.regularizedEscapeDistance_le_word
declarations.type:

      0 ≤ ε →
        ∀ (l : List G),
          DirectedCycles.regularizedEscapeDistance A ε l.prod ≤
            (List.map (DirectedCycles.escapeNorm A) l).sum + ↑l.length * ε

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.regularizedEscapeDistance_mul_le
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] {A : Set G},

      0 ≤ ε →
        ∀ (g h : G),
          DirectedCycles.regularizedEscapeDistance A ε (g * h) ≤
            DirectedCycles.regularizedEscapeDistance A ε g + DirectedCycles.regularizedEscapeDistance A ε h

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.regularizedEscapeDistance_nonneg
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] {A : Set G},
  1 ∈ A → ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 ≤ ε → ∀ (g : G), 0 ≤ DirectedCycles.regularizedEscapeDistance A ε g

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.regularizedEscapeDistance_one
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] {A : Set G},

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.relationBall_card_bounds
declarations.type:

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.relationBall_card_lower_bound
declarations.type:

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.relationBall_card_strict
declarations.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [Finite V] (R : DirectedCycles.Digraph V) (e : V),

      DirectedCycles.relationBall R e n ≠ Set.univ →

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.relationBall_eq_univ_of_stable
declarations.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} (R : DirectedCycles.Digraph V) (e : V),

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.relationBall_iff_reachWithin
declarations.type:

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.relationBall_mono
declarations.type: ∀ {V : Type u_1} (R : DirectedCycles.Digraph V) (e : V), Monotone (DirectedCycles.relationBall R e)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.relativeFactor_exponent

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.relativeFactor_isMulCommutative
declarations.type:

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.relativeSeries_central_of_next_eq_bot
declarations.type:

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.relativeSeries_le_lower
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (K : Subgroup G) (i : ℕ),

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.relativeSeries_map
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {Q : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Group Q] (f : G →* Q),

      Subgroup.map f (DirectedCycles.relativeSeries N n) = DirectedCycles.relativeSeries (Subgroup.map f N) n

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.relativeSeries_normal
declarations.type: ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (K : Subgroup G) [K.Normal] (i : ℕ), (DirectedCycles.relativeSeries K i).Normal

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.relativeSeries_pow_mem
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (K : Subgroup G) [K.Normal] (e : ℕ),

    ∀ (i : ℕ) (x : ↥(DirectedCycles.relativeSeries K i)), ↑x ^ e ∈ DirectedCycles.relativeSeries K (i + 1)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.relativeSeries_quotient_eq_bot
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (S : Set G) (L : Subgroup G) [inst_1 : L.Normal] (n : ℕ),
  DirectedCycles.relativeSeries (Subgroup.normalClosure S) n ≤ L →
    DirectedCycles.relativeSeries (Subgroup.normalClosure (⇑(QuotientGroup.mk' L) '' S)) n = ⊥

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.relativeSeries_step_le
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (K : Subgroup G) [K.Normal] (i : ℕ),
  DirectedCycles.relativeSeries K (i + 1) ≤ DirectedCycles.relativeSeries K i

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.relative_commutator_image_central
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [inst_1 : N.Normal] (i j : ℕ),
  ∀ z ∈ ⁅DirectedCycles.relativeSeries N i, DirectedCycles.lowerSeries G j⁆,
    (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.relativeSeries N (i + j + 2))) z ∈
      Subgroup.center (G ⧸ DirectedCycles.relativeSeries N (i + j + 2))

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.relative_derived_commutator_le
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (i : ℕ),
  ⁅DirectedCycles.relativeSeries N i, commutator G⁆ ≤ DirectedCycles.relativeSeries N (i + 2)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.relative_internal_subgroup_components
declarations.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (u : Ultrafilter ι) (G : ι → Type u_2) [inst : (i : ι) → Group (G i)]
  (H : Subgroup (DirectedCycles.GroupUltraproduct (↑u) G)) (N : Subgroup ↥H) (A : (i : ι) → Finset (G i)),
  (DirectedCycles.ultraSet (↑u) G fun i => ↑(A i)) ⊆ ↑H →
    DirectedCycles.IsInternalFiniteIn u G H ↑N →
      (↑N ⊆ ⇑H.subtype ⁻¹' DirectedCycles.ultraSet (↑u) G fun i => ↑(A i)) →
        ∃ B, DirectedCycles.ultraSubgroup (↑u) G B = Subgroup.map H.subtype N ∧ ∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑u, ↑(B i) ⊆ ↑(A i)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.relative_lowerSeries_commutator_le
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (i j : ℕ),
  ⁅DirectedCycles.relativeSeries N i, DirectedCycles.lowerSeries G j⁆ ≤ DirectedCycles.relativeSeries N (i + j + 1)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.removing_bounded_stabilizers
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [Fintype V] [inst_3 : MulAction G V]
  (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] [Group.IsNilpotent ↥N] (x : V),
  (∀ (u v : V), ∃ g, g • u = v) →
    ∀ (B r c : ℕ),
      (∀ (v : V), Nat.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer G v) ≤ B) →
        Group.rank ↥N ≤ r →
          Group.nilpotencyClass ↥N ≤ c →
            ∃ L,
              ∃ (hL : L.Normal),
                L ≤ N ∧
                  Nat.card ↥L ≤ B ^ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range c, (∑ j ∈ Finset.range c, r ^ (j + 1)) ^ (i + 1) ∧
                    Group.rank (↥N ⧸ Subgroup.comap N.subtype L) ≤ r ∧
                      Group.nilpotencyClass (↥N ⧸ Subgroup.comap N.subtype L) ≤ c ∧
                        ∃ a,
                          (∀ (g : ↥N ⧸ Subgroup.comap N.subtype L) (q : Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel (↥L) V)),
                              g • q = q → g = 1) ∧
                            Nat.card
                                  (Quotient
                                    (MulAction.orbitRel (↥N ⧸ Subgroup.comap N.subtype L)
                                      (Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel (↥L) V)))) ≤
                                N.index ∧
                              Nat.card V ≤ Nat.card (Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel (↥L) V)) * Nat.card ↥L

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.repeated_regular_euler_sequence
declarations.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype V] (D : DirectedCycles.Digraph V),
  DirectedCycles.StronglyConnected D →
    ∀ (d : ℕ),
      0 < d →
        0 < Fintype.card V →
          (∀ (v : V), (Finset.filter (D v) Finset.univ).card = d) →
            (∀ (v : V), {u | D u v}.card = d) →
              ∀ (k : ℕ),
                0 < k →
                  ∃ N A,
                    N = k * Fintype.card V * d ∧
                      ∃ (hA : ∀ (i : Fin N), D (A i) (A ((finRotate N) i))),
                        ∀ (f : { e // D e.1 e.2 } → ℝ), ∑ i, f ⟨(A i, A ((finRotate N) i)), ⋯⟩ = ↑k * ∑ e, f e

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.representationEquiv_apply
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] (T : G →* Module.End ℤ V) (g : G) (v : V),
  (DirectedCycles.representationEquiv T g) v = (T g) v

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.representationEquiv_zpow
declarations.type:

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.representation_difference_range_invariant
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] (T : G →* Module.End ℤ V) (a : G),
  (∀ (g : G), Commute (T g) (T a)) → ∀ (g : G), (1 - T a).range ≤ Submodule.comap (T g) (1 - T a).range

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.representing_round_prefix
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (xs ys : List G),
  DirectedCycles.SingleChangeWord xs ys →
    ∀ (x z : G),
      z = x * ys.prod →
        ∀ k ≤ xs.length,
          x * (List.take k ys).prod = x * (List.take k xs).prod ∨
            x * (List.take k ys).prod = z * xs.prod⁻¹ * (List.take k xs).prod

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.residual_balanced

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.residuePower_add
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (a : G) [NeZero (orderOf a)] (x y : ZMod (orderOf a)),

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.residuePower_central
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G],

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.residuePower_injective
declarations.type: ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (a : G) [NeZero (orderOf a)], Function.Injective (DirectedCycles.residuePower a)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.residuePower_intCast
declarations.type: ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (a : G) [NeZero (orderOf a)] (z : ℤ), DirectedCycles.residuePower a ↑z = a ^ z

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.residuePower_natCast
declarations.type: ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (a : G) (n : ℕ), DirectedCycles.residuePower a ↑n = a ^ n

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.residuePower_neg
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (a : G) [NeZero (orderOf a)] (x : ZMod (orderOf a)),
  DirectedCycles.residuePower a (-x) = (DirectedCycles.residuePower a x)⁻¹

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.residuePower_zero
declarations.type: ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (a : G), DirectedCycles.residuePower a 0 = 1

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.residue_collision_difference
declarations.type:
∀ {Q : Type u_1} [inst : Group Q] (a : Q) [NeZero (orderOf a)] (g g' t : Q) (e v w : ZMod (orderOf a)) (u u' : ℕ),
  g * t * g'⁻¹ = DirectedCycles.residuePower a e →
    DirectedCycles.residuePower a (w + ↑u') * g' = DirectedCycles.residuePower a (v + ↑u) * g * t → w - v = e + ↑u - ↑u'

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.residue_run_closure
declarations.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (h D : ℕ) [NeZero h] (σ : Equiv.Perm I) (v ν : I → ZMod h),
  ∑ i, (↑(v i - v (σ i) - (↑D + ν i)).val + ↑D) + ∑ i, ν i = 0

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.restrictedLayer_roundProducts_image
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] {T : ℕ} (S : ZMod T → Set G) (C : Subgroup G),

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.restrictedLayer_rounds_generate
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] {T : ℕ} (S : ZMod T → Set G) (C : Subgroup G),

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.restricted_internal_finite_along
declarations.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (U : Ultrafilter ι) (G : ι → Type u_2) [inst : (i : ι) → Group (G i)] {S : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Group S]
  (e : S →* DirectedCycles.GroupUltraproduct (↑U) G) (H : Subgroup S) (T : Set ↥H),
  DirectedCycles.RestrictedInternal H (DirectedCycles.IsInternalFiniteAlong U G e) T ↔

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.retainedLayerEquiv_apply
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (a : G) (D : ℕ) (data : List (ℕ × G)) (hne : data ≠ [])

    ∀ (t : I → G) (Q₀ : Set I),
      (∀ z ∈ Q₀, z ≠ root → t z = a) →
        ∀ (isA : Fin C.length → Prop)
          (P :
            (i : Fin C.length) →
              DirectedCycles.SimplePath (DirectedCycles.VoltageDigraph S) (C.vertex i, root)
                (C.vertex ((finRotate C.length) i), root)),
          (∀ (i : Fin C.length), ∀ z ∈ (P i).vertices.dropLast, z.2 = root → z.1 = C.vertex i) →
            (∀ (i : Fin C.length), isA i → ∀ z ∈ (P i).vertices.dropLast, z.1 = C.vertex i ∧ z.2 ∈ Q₀) →
              (∀ (i : Fin C.length),
                  ¬isA i →
                    ∀ z ∈ (P i).vertices.dropLast,
                      z.1 = C.vertex i ∨ z.1 = C.vertex ((finRotate C.length) i) * (t z.2)⁻¹) →
                (∀ (i j : Fin C.length), i ≠ j → ¬isA i → ¬isA j → (P i).vertices.Disjoint (P j).vertices) →
                  ∃ L, C.length ≤ L.length

  t root = 1 →
    (∀ z ∈ Q₀, z ≠ root → t z = a) →
      ∀ (S : Set (G ⧸ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) (C : DirectedCycles.Cycle (DirectedCycles.CayleyDigraph S))
        (s : Fin C.length → G)
        (hstep :
          ∀ (i : Fin C.length),
            C.vertex ((finRotate C.length) i) =
              C.vertex i * (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) (s i))
        (D : ℕ) (X : DirectedCycles.SeparatedLiftInput a S C s hstep (fun z => t ↑z) D),
        2 * D + 2 ≤ orderOf ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a) →
          ∀ (A : DirectedCycles.SimplePath (DirectedCycles.VoltageDigraph V) (1, root) (a, root)),
            (∀ (x : G), ∀ z ∈ (A.translateRoot x).vertices.dropLast, z.1 = x ∧ z.2 ∈ Q₀) →
              ∀
                (P :
                  (k : Fin C.length) →
                    DirectedCycles.SimplePath (DirectedCycles.VoltageDigraph V) (1, root) (s k, root)),
                (∀ (k : Fin C.length), ∀ z ∈ (P k).vertices, z.1 = 1 ∨ z.1 = s k * (t z.2)⁻¹) →
                  (∀ (k : Fin C.length),
                      (List.map (fun z => ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) z.1, z.2))
                          (P k).vertices).Nodup) →
                    ∀ (Q : DirectedCycles.Cycle (DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGraph a D X.data ⋯)),
                      ∃ L, Q.length ≤ L.length

declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {I : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Finite G] (a : G) (root : I) (Q₀ : Set I) (t : I → G),
  t root = 1 →
    (∀ z ∈ Q₀, z ≠ root → t z = a) →
      ∀ (S : Set (G ⧸ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) (C : DirectedCycles.Cycle (DirectedCycles.CayleyDigraph S))
        (s : Fin C.length → G)
        (hstep :
          ∀ (i : Fin C.length),
            C.vertex ((finRotate C.length) i) =
              C.vertex i * (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) (s i))
        (D : ℕ) (X : DirectedCycles.SeparatedLiftInput a S C s hstep (fun z => t ↑z) D),
        2 * D + 2 ≤ orderOf ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a) →
          ∀ (i j : Fin C.length),
            i ≠ j →
              ∀ (u u' : ℕ),
                u ≤ D →
                  u' ≤ D →
                    ∀ (x y : G),
                      (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) x =
                          DirectedCycles.residuePower ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a)
                              (X.residues i + ↑u) *
                            (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a))
                              (List.take (↑i) (List.ofFn s)).prod →
                        (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) y =
                            DirectedCycles.residuePower ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a)
                                (X.residues j + ↑u') *
                              (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a))
                                (List.take (↑j + 1) (List.ofFn s)).prod →
                          ∀ (z : I), y ≠ x * t z

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.short_connections_from_heavy
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype V] [Fintype W]

  (∀ (a : W), Fintype.card { x // π x = a } = m) →
    DirectedCycles.StronglyConnected (DirectedCycles.QuotientDigraph D π) →
      (∀ (a b : W), ∃ g, g • a = b) →
        (∀ (g : G) (a b : W),
            DirectedCycles.QuotientDigraph D π (g • a) (g • b) ↔ DirectedCycles.QuotientDigraph D π a b) →
          (∀ (g : G) (a b : W),
              DirectedCycles.HeavyReach D π u m (g • a) (g • b) ↔ DirectedCycles.HeavyReach D π u m a b) →
            (∃ a b, DirectedCycles.HeavyReach D π u m a b) →
              (∀ (a b : W),
                  DirectedCycles.HeavyReach D π u m a b →
                    (∀ (x : { v // π v = a }), m < 2 * {y | DirectedCycles.ReachWithin D u ↑x ↑y}.card) ∧
                      ∀ (y : { v // π v = b }), m < 2 * {x | DirectedCycles.ReachWithin D u ↑x ↑y}.card) →
                (∀ (a b : W), DirectedCycles.QuotientDigraph D π a b → ∃ F, ∀ (x : { x // π x = a }), D ↑x ↑(F x)) →
                  ∃ Q,
                    DirectedCycles.Loopless Q ∧
                      DirectedCycles.StronglyConnected Q ∧
                        (∀ (g : G) (a b : W), Q (g • a) (g • b) ↔ Q a b) ∧
                          ∀ (a b : W),
                            Q a b → ∀ (x : { v // π v = a }) (y : { v // π v = b }), ∃ P, P.length ≤ 2 * u + 1

declarations.type:

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.smaller_word_exit_selection
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] {ι : Type u_2} {l : Filter ι} (Q : ι → Set G)
  (r : ι → ℕ) {U O : Set G},
  IsOpen O →
    1 ∈ O →
      O ⊆ U →
        (∀ (i : ι), 1 ∈ Q i) →
          (∀ (i : ι), (Q i)⁻¹ = Q i) →
            (∀ (V : Set G), IsOpen V → 1 ∈ V → ∀ᶠ (i : ι) in l, ∀ q ∈ Q i, ∀ (j : ℕ), q ^ j ∈ V) →
              (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in l, ¬↑(Subgroup.closure (Q i)) ⊆ U) →
                (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in l, ∀ (k : ℕ), Q i ^ k ⊆ U → k ≤ r i) →
                  ∃ s g, ∀ᶠ (i : ι) in l, 0 < s i ∧ s i ≤ r i ∧ Q i ^ s i ⊆ O ∧ g i ∈ Q i ^ (s i + 1) ∧ g i ∉ O

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.smooth_axis_norm_bound
declarations.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] (f : E × E → E),

      (fun y => f (0, y)) =ᶠ[nhds 0] id → ∃ r, 0 < r ∧ ∀ (x y : E), ‖x‖ < r → ‖y‖ < r → ‖f (x, y)‖ ≤ 2 * ‖y‖

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.smooth_identity_chart
declarations.type:

  ∃ a,
    0 ∈ a.source ∧

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.smooth_local_coordinate_domain
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace G] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [inst_3 : ChartedSpace E G] (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G),
  DirectedCycles.LocalGroupSmoothness L →
    ∀ (a : OpenPartialHomeomorph E G),
      0 ∈ a.source →
        ↑a 0 = L.one →
          ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (↑⊤) (↑a) a.source →
            ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (↑⊤) (↑a.symm) a.target →
              ∃ μ S,
                IsOpen S ∧
                  (0, 0) ∈ S ∧
                    μ (0, 0) = 0 ∧
                      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) μ S ∧
                        (∀ p ∈ S, L.mulRel (↑a p.1) (↑a p.2) (↑a (μ p))) ∧
                          (fun x => μ (x, 0)) =ᶠ[nhds 0] id ∧
                            (fun x => μ (0, x)) =ᶠ[nhds 0] id ∧
                              ∀ᶠ (p : E × E) in nhds (0, 0),
                                (fun z => μ (μ (p.1, p.2), z)) =ᶠ[nhds 0] fun z => μ (p.1, μ (p.2, z))

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.smooth_local_coordinate_law_at_identity
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace G] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [inst_3 : ChartedSpace E G] (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G),

            ContMDiffAt (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (↑⊤) (↑a.symm) L.one →
              ∃ μ,
                μ (0, 0) = 0 ∧
                  ContDiffAt ℝ (↑⊤) μ (0, 0) ∧
                    (∀ᶠ (p : E × E) in nhds (0, 0), L.mulRel (↑a p.1) (↑a p.2) (↑a (μ p))) ∧
                      (fun x => μ (x, 0)) =ᶠ[nhds 0] id ∧
                        (fun x => μ (0, x)) =ᶠ[nhds 0] id ∧
                          ∀ᶠ (p : E × E) in nhds (0, 0),
                            (fun z => μ (μ (p.1, p.2), z)) =ᶠ[nhds 0] fun z => μ (p.1, μ (p.2, z))

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.smooth_local_curve_contMDiffAt_interior
declarations.type:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace H] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [inst_3 : ChartedSpace E H] (Q : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra H),

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.smooth_local_curve_nonzero_tangent
declarations.type:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace H] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [CompleteSpace E] [inst_4 : ChartedSpace E H] [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (↑⊤) H]
  (Q : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra H),
  DirectedCycles.LocalGroupSmoothness Q →
    ∀ (f : ℝ → H),
      f 0 = Q.one →
        ContinuousAt f 0 →
          (∀ (s t : ℝ), |s| + |t| ≤ 1 → Q.mulRel (f s) (f t) (f (s + t))) →
            f 1 ≠ Q.one →
              ContMDiffAt (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ℝ) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (↑⊤) f 0 ∧
                ∃ a,
                  0 ∈ a.source ∧
                    ↑a 0 = Q.one ∧
                      ContMDiffAt (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (↑⊤) (↑a) 0 ∧
                        ContMDiffAt (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (↑⊤) (↑a.symm) Q.one ∧
                          ∃ v, v ≠ 0 ∧ HasDerivAt (fun t => ↑a.symm (f t)) v 0

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.smooth_local_curve_product_coordinates
declarations.type:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace H] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [inst_4 : ChartedSpace E H] [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (↑⊤) H]
  (Q : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra H),
  DirectedCycles.LocalGroupSmoothness Q →
    ∀ (f : ℝ → H),
      f 0 = Q.one →
        ContinuousAt f 0 →
          (∀ (s t : ℝ), |s| + |t| ≤ 1 → Q.mulRel (f s) (f t) (f (s + t))) →
            f 1 ≠ Q.one →
              ∃ v ℓ,
                v ≠ 0 ∧
                  ℓ v = 1 ∧
                    Module.finrank ℝ ↥(↑ℓ).ker + 1 = Module.finrank ℝ E ∧
                      ∃ b σ,
                        0 ∈ b.source ∧
                          ↑b 0 = Q.one ∧
                            σ 0 = Q.one ∧
                              ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (ℝ × ↥(↑ℓ).ker)) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (↑⊤) (↑b)
                                  b.source ∧
                                ContMDiffOn (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (ℝ × ↥(↑ℓ).ker)) (↑⊤)
                                    (↑b.symm) b.target ∧
                                  ∀ᶠ (p : ℝ × ↥(↑ℓ).ker) in nhds 0, Q.mulRel (f p.1) (σ p.2) (↑b p)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.smooth_local_difference_cell
declarations.type:

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.smooth_local_group_compact_nss
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace G] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace ℝ E]

declarations.type:

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.smooth_local_model_escape_control
declarations.type:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace H] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [inst_4 : ChartedSpace E H] [IsManifold (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (↑⊤) H]
  (M : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra H),
  DirectedCycles.LocalGroupSmoothness M →
    ∀ {O : Set H},
      O ∈ nhds M.one →
        ∃ V ∈ nhds M.one,
          IsCompact V ∧
            V ⊆ O ∧
              M.IsNSS V ∧
                ∀ (ι : Type u_3) (U : Ultrafilter ι) (G : ι → Type u_4)
                  (L : (i : ι) → DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra (G i)) (A : (i : ι) → Set (G i)),
                  (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, (L i).one ∈ A i) →

                          ∃ r,

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.spanning_cycle_lift
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [Finite G] [Group.IsNilpotent G] (a : G) (S : Set G),
  a ∈ S →
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      Group.nilpotencyClass G ≤ n →
        8 * (n + 1) + 4 <
            Nat.card
              (↥(DirectedCycles.elementClosure a) ⧸
                (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a).subgroupOf (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) →
          ∀
            (Q :
              DirectedCycles.Cycle
                (DirectedCycles.CayleyDigraph (⇑(QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) '' S))),
            DirectedCycles.SpansTruncation (n + 1) (Set.range ⇑Q.vertex) →
              ∀ (b eta : ℝ),
                0 ≤ b →
                  DirectedCycles.LayerSpanningBound (↥(DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) (n + 1) b eta →
                    DirectedCycles.AbovePrimeCutoff G (n + 1) →
                      ∃ C,
                        b / 4 * ↑Q.length * ↑(Nat.card ↥(DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) *
                              ↑(Nat.card ↥(DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) ^ (-eta) ≤
                            ↑C.length ∧
                          C.ClosedUnderGenerator a ∧ DirectedCycles.SpansTruncation (n + 1) (C.generatorTails a)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.sparse_invariant_connected
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : Fintype V] [inst_3 : MulAction G V]
  (D : DirectedCycles.Digraph V),
  DirectedCycles.StronglyConnected D →
    (∀ (g : G) (x y : V), D (g • x) (g • y) ↔ D x y) →
      (∀ (x y : V), ∃ g, g • x = y) →
        ∀ (a : V) (B : ℕ),
          Fintype.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer G a) ≤ B →
            ∃ E,
              (∀ (x y : V), E x y → D x y) ∧
                (∀ (g : G) (x y : V), E (g • x) (g • y) ↔ E x y) ∧
                  (Finset.filter (E a) Finset.univ).card ≤ B * ⌈Real.log ↑(Fintype.card V) / Real.log 2⌉₊ ∧
                    DirectedCycles.StronglyConnected E

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.sparse_invariant_steps
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : Fintype V] [inst_3 : MulAction G V]
  (D : DirectedCycles.Digraph V),
  DirectedCycles.StronglyConnected D →
    (∀ (g : G) (x y : V), D (g • x) (g • y) ↔ D x y) →
      (∀ (x y : V), ∃ g, g • x = y) →
        ∀ (a : V) (B : ℕ),
          Fintype.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer G a) ≤ B →
            ∀ (k : ℕ),
              ∃ E,
                (∀ (x y : V), E x y → D x y) ∧
                  (∀ (g : G) (x y : V), E (g • x) (g • y) ↔ E x y) ∧
                    (Finset.filter (E a) Finset.univ).card ≤ B * k ∧
                      (DirectedCycles.Connected E ∨ 2 ^ k ≤ (DirectedCycles.weakComponent E a).card)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.sparse_invariant_subdigraph
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : Fintype V] [inst_3 : MulAction G V]
  (D : DirectedCycles.Digraph V),
  DirectedCycles.Loopless D →
    DirectedCycles.StronglyConnected D →
      (∀ (g : G) (x y : V), D (g • x) (g • y) ↔ D x y) →
        (∀ (x y : V), ∃ g, g • x = y) →
          2 ≤ Fintype.card V →
            ∀ (B : ℕ),
              (∀ (a : V), Fintype.card ↥(MulAction.stabilizer G a) ≤ B) →
                ∃ E d,
                  (∀ (x y : V), E x y → D x y) ∧
                    DirectedCycles.Loopless E ∧
                      (∀ (g : G) (x y : V), E (g • x) (g • y) ↔ E x y) ∧
                        DirectedCycles.StronglyConnected E ∧
                          (∀ (x : V), (Finset.filter (E x) Finset.univ).card = d) ∧

  (bad₁ : C → Finset A) (bad₂ : E → Finset A) (d₁ d₂ w₁ w₂ : ℕ),
  (∀ (c : C), src₁ c ≠ dst₁ c) →
    (∀ (c : E), src₂ c ≠ dst₂ c) →
      (∀ (c : C), (bad₁ c).card ≤ w₁) →
        (∀ (c : E), (bad₂ c).card ≤ w₂) →
          (∀ (i : I), {c | src₁ c = i ∨ dst₁ c = i}.card ≤ d₁) →
            (∀ (i : I), {c | src₂ c = i ∨ dst₂ c = i}.card ≤ d₂) →
              d₁ * w₁ + d₂ * w₂ < Fintype.card A →
                ∃ v, (∀ (c : C), v (dst₁ c) - v (src₁ c) ∉ bad₁ c) ∧ ∀ (c : E), v (dst₂ c) - v (src₂ c) ∉ bad₂ c

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.uniform_central_quotient_window
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] {A : Set G},
  1 ∈ A →
    A⁻¹ = A →
      ∀ (C : ℕ),
        (∀ (x : G), (∀ (j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → j ≤ C → x ^ j ∈ A ^ 2) → x ∈ A) →
          ∀ {B D : ℝ},
            0 < B →
              0 ≤ D →
                (∀ (l : List G),
                    DirectedCycles.escapeNorm A l.prod ≤ B * (List.map (DirectedCycles.escapeNorm A) l).sum) →
                  ∀ {u : G},
                    0 < DirectedCycles.escapeNorm A u →
                      (∀ v ∈ A, v ≠ 1 → DirectedCycles.escapeNorm A u ≤ DirectedCycles.escapeNorm A v) →
                        (∀ x ∈ A,
                            DirectedCycles.escapeNorm A (x⁻¹ * u⁻¹ * x * u) ≤
                              D * DirectedCycles.escapeNorm A x * DirectedCycles.escapeNorm A u) →
                          ∀ {N : ℕ},
                            0 < N →
                              u ^ N ∉ A →
                                (∀ i < N, u ^ i ∈ A) →
                                  have δ := DirectedCycles.centralQuotientRadius C B D;
                                  0 < δ ∧
                                    δ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
                                      (∀ x ∈ DirectedCycles.escapeSublevel A δ, Commute x u) ∧
                                        ∃ V,
                                          DirectedCycles.LocalNormalSet (DirectedCycles.shortPowerProgression u N) V ∧
                                            DirectedCycles.escapeSublevel A δ ^ 6 ⊆ V

declarations.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup P]
  (μ : E × E → E) (V : P → E → E),
  ContDiffAt ℝ 1 μ (0, 0) →
    (fun x => μ (x, 0)) =ᶠ[nhds 0] id →
      (∀ᶠ (p : E × E) in nhds (0, 0), ∀ (v : P), (fderiv ℝ μ p) (0, V v p.2) = V v (μ p)) →
        ∀ S ∈ nhds 0,
          ∀ (K : NNReal),
            (∀ᶠ (v : P) in nhds 0, LipschitzOnWith K (V v) S) →
              ∀ (f : P × ℝ → E),
                ContinuousAt f (0, 0) →
                  (∀ᶠ (v : P) in nhds 0, f (v, 0) = 0) →
                    (∀ᶠ (p : P × ℝ) in nhds (0, 0), HasDerivAt (fun t => f (p.1, t)) (V p.1 (f p)) p.2) →
                      ∃ R r,
                        0 < R ∧
                          0 < r ∧
                            ∀ (v : P), ‖v‖ < R → ∀ (s t : ℝ), |s| + |t| ≤ r → f (v, s + t) = μ (f (v, s), f (v, t))

      0 < r →
        (∀ (v : E), ‖v‖ < R → f (v, 0) = 0 ∧ HasDerivAt (fun t => f (v, t)) v 0) →
          (∀ (v : E), ‖v‖ < R → ∀ (a b : ℝ), |a| + |b| ≤ r → f (v, a + b) = μ (f (v, a), f (v, b))) →
            ∀ (v : E), ‖v‖ < R → ∀ (s : ℝ), |s| ≤ 1 → ∀ (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ r → f (s • v, t) = f (v, s * t)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.walk_expansion
declarations.type:
∀ {V : Type u_1} {D Q : DirectedCycles.Digraph V} (C : DirectedCycles.Cycle Q) (τ : Fin C.length → V)
  (P : (i : Fin C.length) → DirectedCycles.SimplePath D (C.vertex i) (C.vertex ((finRotate C.length) i))),
  (∀ (i j : Fin C.length),
      ∀ v ∈ (P i).vertices.dropLast,
        v ∈ (P j).vertices.dropLast →
          C.vertex i = C.vertex j ∨
            C.vertex ((finRotate C.length) i) = C.vertex ((finRotate C.length) j) ∨
              C.vertex ((finRotate C.length) j) = τ i ∨ C.vertex ((finRotate C.length) i) = τ j) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin C.length), τ i = C.vertex j → j = (finRotate C.length) i) →
      ∃ L,
        L.length = ∑ i, (P i).length ∧
          C.length ≤ L.length ∧ List.ofFn ⇑L.vertex = (List.ofFn fun i => (P i).vertices.dropLast).flatten

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.weakComponent_doubles

  (∀ (g : G) (x y : V), D (g • x) (g • y) ↔ D x y) →
    (∀ (x y : V), D x y → E x y) →
      (∀ (x y : V), ∃ g, g • x = y) →
        ∀ (a b : V),
          ¬DirectedCycles.WeakReach D a b →
            E a b → 2 * (DirectedCycles.weakComponent D a).card ≤ (DirectedCycles.weakComponent E a).card

    ∀ (S : Finset V), DirectedCycles.cutOut w S = DirectedCycles.cutIn w S

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.weighted_expansion_partition
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [inst : Group G] [Fintype G] [inst_2 : Fintype V] [inst_3 : Fintype W]
  [DecidableEq V] [inst_5 : DecidableEq W] [inst_6 : MulAction G V] (D : DirectedCycles.Digraph V) (π : V → W),
  (∀ (g : G) (x y : V), D (g • x) (g • y) ↔ D x y) →
    (∀ (g : G) (x y : V), π (g • x) = π (g • y) ↔ π x = π y) →
      (∀ (x y : V), ∃ g, g • x = y) →
        ∀ (m : ℕ),
          2 ≤ m →
            ∀ (ρ : ℝ),
              1 ≤ ρ →
                (∀ (a : W), {x | π x = a}.card = m) →
                  (∀ (x y : V), π x = π y → ∃ P, ↑P.length ≤ ρ) →
                    ∀ (S : Finset V),
                      have numerator := ∑ a, ↑{x ∈ S | π x = a}.card * (↑m - ↑{x ∈ S | π x = a}.card);
                      numerator / ((↑m - 1) * ρ) ≤ ↑(DirectedCycles.outBoundary D S).card ∧
                        numerator / ((↑m - 1) * ρ) ≤ ↑(DirectedCycles.inBoundary D S).card

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.weighted_expansion_relation
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [Fintype G] [inst_2 : Fintype V] [inst_3 : DecidableEq V]
  [inst_4 : MulAction G V] (D E : DirectedCycles.Digraph V) [inst_5 : DecidableRel E],
  (∀ (g : G) (x y : V), D (g • x) (g • y) ↔ D x y) →
    (∀ (g : G) (x y : V), E (g • x) (g • y) ↔ E x y) →
      (∀ (x y : V), ∃ g, g • x = y) →
        (∀ (x : V), E x x) →
          (∀ {x y : V}, E x y → E y x) →
            ∀ (m : ℕ),
              2 ≤ m →
                ∀ (ρ : ℝ),
                  1 ≤ ρ →
                    (∀ (x : V), (Finset.filter (E x) Finset.univ).card = m) →
                      (∀ (x y : V), E x y → ∃ P, ↑P.length ≤ ρ) →
                        ∀ (S : Finset V),
                          DirectedCycles.crossWeight E S / ((↑m - 1) * ρ) ≤ ↑(DirectedCycles.outBoundary D S).card ∧
                            DirectedCycles.crossWeight E S / ((↑m - 1) * ρ) ≤ ↑(DirectedCycles.inBoundary D S).card

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.ExpansionBand.successor_cases
declarations.type:
∀ {l D h : ℕ} (hl : 0 < l),
  l + 2 * D + 2 ≤ h →
    ∀ (x y : DirectedCycles.ExpansionBand l D),
      (DirectedCycles.ExpansionBand.coordinate h x + 1) % h = DirectedCycles.ExpansionBand.coordinate h y →
        (∃ i j, x = DirectedCycles.ExpansionBand.fixed i ∧ y = DirectedCycles.ExpansionBand.fixed j ∧ ↑i + 1 = ↑j) ∨
          (∃ i,
              x = DirectedCycles.ExpansionBand.fixed i ∧
                y = DirectedCycles.ExpansionBand.outgoing ⟨0, ⋯⟩ ∧ ↑i + 1 = l) ∨
            (∃ i j,
                x = DirectedCycles.ExpansionBand.outgoing i ∧
                  y = DirectedCycles.ExpansionBand.outgoing j ∧ ↑i + 1 = ↑j) ∨
              (∃ i j,
                  x = DirectedCycles.ExpansionBand.incoming i ∧
                    y = DirectedCycles.ExpansionBand.incoming j ∧ ↑j + 1 = ↑i) ∨
                ∃ i,
                  x = DirectedCycles.ExpansionBand.incoming i ∧ y = DirectedCycles.ExpansionBand.fixed ⟨0, hl⟩ ∧ ↑i = 0

          (∀ (e : Fin E.length), q (E.vertex e) = r (E.position e) * q a ^ E.level e) →

              a ∈ S →

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.FiniteAlmostPeriods.approximate_finite_intersection_density
declarations.type:

  IsApproximateSubgroup K ↑A →
    0 ≤ δ →
      ∀ (l : List (Finset G)),
        (∀ C ∈ l, C ⊆ A) →
          (∀ C ∈ l, δ * ↑A.card ≤ ↑C.card) →
            ∃ B ⊆ A, (δ / K) ^ l.length * ↑A.card ≤ ↑B.card ∧ ∀ C ∈ l, ↑B / ↑B ⊆ ↑C / ↑C

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.FiniteAlmostPeriods.approximate_intersection_density
declarations.type:

  IsApproximateSubgroup K ↑A →
    0 ≤ δ₁ →
      0 ≤ δ₂ →
        A₁ ⊆ A →
          A₂ ⊆ A →
            δ₁ * ↑A.card ≤ ↑A₁.card →
              δ₂ * ↑A.card ≤ ↑A₂.card → ∃ B ⊆ A, δ₁ * δ₂ / K * ↑A.card ≤ ↑B.card ∧ ↑B / ↑B ⊆ ↑A₁ / ↑A₁ ∩ (↑A₂ / ↑A₂)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.FiniteAlmostPeriods.approximate_power_left_cover

      S ⊆ A ^ 16 →
        δ * ↑A.card ≤ ↑S.card → S⁻¹ = S → ∃ X, 1 ∈ X ∧ X ⊆ A ^ 4 ∧ X.card ≤ ⌈K ^ 19 / δ⌉₊ + 1 ∧ ↑A ^ 4 ⊆ ↑X * ↑S ^ 2

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.FiniteAlmostPeriods.dense_almost_periods
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : DecidableEq G] (A B : Finset G) (K ε t δ : ℝ),
  IsApproximateSubgroup K ↑A →
    0 ≤ ε →
      0 ≤ t →
        0 ≤ δ →
          B ⊆ A →

declarations.type:

      0 ≤ A →
        (∀ (x : E) (t : ℝ),

                      (DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.coordinateExp D e y) +

                dist (DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.coordinateExp D e x)
                    (DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.coordinateExp D e y) ≤

    r ≤ 1 / (8 * D.constant) →

                            (DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.coordinateExp D e y) +

                        (DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.coordinateExp D e y) ≤
                      2 * ↑n * D.gauge (DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.coordinateExp D e ((1 / ↑n) • (y - x))) +

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.no_nearest_normalized_power_family
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] (D : DirectedCycles.GleasonMetricData G)
  [IsTopologicalGroup G] [LocallyCompactSpace G] {ι : Type u_2} {l : Filter ι} [l.NeBot]
  {K : Set (DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra D)},
  K ∈ nhds 0 →
    ∀ {r R : ℝ},
      0 < r →
        0 < R →
          R ≤ r →
            r ≤ 1 / (8 * D.constant) →
              (∀ (a b : G) (n : ℕ),
                  0 < n →
                    ↑n * D.gauge a ≤ r →
                      ↑n * D.gauge b ≤ r →
                        ↑n / (2 * D.constant) * dist a b ≤ dist (a ^ n) (b ^ n) ∧
                          dist (a ^ n) (b ^ n) ≤ 2 * ↑n * dist a b) →
                ∀ (g k : ι → G) (x : ι → DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra D) (N : ι → ℕ),
                  Filter.Tendsto x l (nhds 0) →
                    Filter.Tendsto N l Filter.atTop →
                      (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in l, g i = DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.exp D (x i) * k i) →
                        (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in l,
                            ∀ y ∈ K, D.gauge (k i) ≤ dist (g i) (DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.exp D y)) →
                          (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in l, 0 < N i ∧ R / 2 ≤ ↑(N i) * D.gauge (k i) ∧ ↑(N i) * D.gauge (k i) ≤ R) →
                            ∀ (v : DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra D),
                              (∀ (t : ℝ),
                                  D.gauge (((DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.toOneParameter D) v).eval t) ≤ R * |t|) →
                                Filter.Tendsto (fun i => k i ^ N i) l
                                    (nhds (DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.exp D v)) →
                                  False

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.GleasonMetricData.approximate_product
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] (D : DirectedCycles.GleasonMetricData G)
  [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup E] (F : E → G),
  F 0 = 1 →
    ∀ {A K R : ℝ},
      0 ≤ A →
        0 ≤ K →
          (∀ (x : E), D.gauge (F x) ≤ A * ‖x‖) →
            (∀ (x y : E), ‖x‖ + ‖y‖ ≤ R → dist (F x * F y) (F (x + y)) ≤ K * ‖x‖ * ‖y‖) →
              ∀ (v : ℕ → E) (n : ℕ),
                2 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, ‖v j‖ ≤ R →
                  2 * A * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, ‖v j‖ ≤ 1 / D.constant →
                    K * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, ‖v j‖) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / D.constant →
                      dist (List.map (fun j => F (v j)) (List.range n)).prod (F (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, v j)) ≤
                        K * 2 * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, ‖v j‖) ^ 2

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.GleasonMetricData.exists_compact_nearest_residual
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] (D : DirectedCycles.GleasonMetricData G) {ι : Type u_2}
  {l : Filter ι} {V : Set G},
  IsCompact V →
    1 ∈ V →
      ∀ (g : ι → G),
        (∀ (i : ι), g i ∉ V) →
          Filter.Tendsto g l (nhds 1) →
            ∃ h k,
              (∀ (i : ι),
                  h i ∈ V ∧
                    k i = (h i)⁻¹ * g i ∧
                      k i ≠ 1 ∧
                        D.gauge (k i) ≤ D.gauge (g i) ∧
                          D.gauge (h i) ≤ 2 * D.gauge (g i) ∧ ∀ v ∈ V, D.gauge (k i) ≤ dist (g i) v) ∧
                Filter.Tendsto h l (nhds 1) ∧ Filter.Tendsto k l (nhds 1)

declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] (D : DirectedCycles.GleasonMetricData G)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.almost_period_domains
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype G] (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G),
  L.DivisionClosed →
    L.Reversible →
      ∀ {K : ℕ} {A : Finset G},
        DirectedCycles.IsLocalFiniteApproximateGroup L K A →
          ∀ (D : Finset G),
            0 < D.card →
              ↑D ⊆ L.wordPower (↑A) 2 →
                ∀ (S : Set G) (ε : ℝ),
                  0 ≤ ε →
                    ∀ (N : ℕ),
                      ↑N * ε < 1 →
                        (∀ g ∈ S, ↑(L.defect D g) ≤ ε * ↑D.card) →
                          L.AllProductsDefined S N ∧ ∀ n ≤ N, L.wordPower S n ⊆ L.wordPower (↑A) 4

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.almost_period_product
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype G] (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G),
  L.DivisionClosed →
    L.Reversible →
      ∀ {K : ℕ} {A : Finset G},
        DirectedCycles.IsLocalFiniteApproximateGroup L K A →
          ∀ (D : Finset G),
            ↑D ⊆ L.wordPower (↑A) 2 →
              ∀ (l : List G),
                (List.map (fun g => ↑(L.defect D g)) l).sum < ↑D.card →
                  ∃ x ∈ L.wordPower (↑A) 4,
                    L.Product l x ∧ ↑(L.defect D x) ≤ (List.map (fun g => ↑(L.defect D g)) l).sum

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.commutator_of_signed_word

        L.Product (L.signedLetters g (w ++ [(j, true)] ++ DirectedCycles.inverseSignedWord w ++ [(j, false)])) z →

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.commuting_products
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G) {A : Set G},

    ∀ {a b c d ab cd ac bd : G},
      a ∈ A →
        b ∈ A →
          c ∈ A →
            d ∈ A →
              L.Commute b c →
                L.mulRel a b ab →
                  L.mulRel c d cd → L.mulRel a c ac → L.mulRel b d bd → ∃ z, L.mulRel ab cd z ∧ L.mulRel ac bd z

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.conjugate_word_domains
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G),
  L.Reversible →
    ∀ {A S : Set G} {N m : ℕ},
      (∀ x ∈ A, L.inv x ∈ A) →
        L.AllProductsDefined A N →
          9 ≤ N →
            9 * m ≤ N →
              S ⊆ A →
                L.AllProductsDefined (L.conjugates S (L.wordPower A 4)) m ∧
                  L.wordPower (L.conjugates S (L.wordPower A 4)) m ⊆ L.wordPower A (9 * m)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.conjugate_zero_escape
declarations.type:

    ∀ {g x z : G},
      L.escapeNorm A x = 0 →
        ∀ {C : ℝ}, L.escapeNorm A z ≤ C * L.escapeNorm A x → L.Product [L.inv g, x, g] z → L.escapeNorm A z = 0

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.conjugates_subset_wordPower_nine

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.convolution_eq_sum_support
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G) [inst : Fintype G] {f k : G → ℝ} (A : Finset G),
  (∀ y ∉ A, f y = 0) → ∀ (x : G), L.convolution f k x = ∑ y ∈ A, f y * L.leftShift y k x

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.convolution_eq_zero
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G) [inst : Fintype G],
  L.Cancellative →
    ∀ {f k : G → ℝ} {A B : Set G},
      (∀ x ∉ A, f x = 0) → (∀ x ∉ B, k x = 0) → ∀ {x : G}, x ∉ L.setMul A B → L.convolution f k x = 0

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.convolution_le_card
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G) [inst : Fintype G] {f k : G → ℝ} (A : Finset G),
  (∀ (y : G), 0 ≤ f y ∧ f y ≤ 1) →
    (∀ (y : G), 0 ≤ k y ∧ k y ≤ 1) → (∀ y ∉ A, f y = 0) → ∀ (x : G), L.convolution f k x ≤ ↑A.card

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.convolution_leftShift
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype G] (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G),
  L.Cancellative →
    ∀ {R : Set G},
      L.AllProductsDefined R 3 →
        ∀ {g : G},
          g ∈ R →
            ∀ (f k : G → ℝ),
              (∀ (x : G), f x ≠ 0 → x ∈ R) →
                (∀ (x : G), k x ≠ 0 → x ∈ R) → L.convolution (L.leftShift g f) k = L.leftShift g (L.convolution f k)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.convolution_nonneg
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G) [inst : Fintype G] {f k : G → ℝ},
  (∀ (x : G), 0 ≤ f x) → (∀ (x : G), 0 ≤ k x) → ∀ (x : G), 0 ≤ L.convolution f k x

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.convolution_one_lower
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G) [inst : Fintype G],
  L.Cancellative →
    ∀ (A : Finset G),
      (∀ a ∈ A, L.inv a ∈ A) →
        ∀ {f k : G → ℝ},
          (∀ (x : G), 0 ≤ f x) →
            (∀ (x : G), 0 ≤ k x) → (∀ x ∈ A, f x = 1) → (∀ x ∈ A, k x = 1) → ↑A.card ≤ L.convolution f k L.one

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.convolution_sub_left
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G) [inst : Fintype G] (f h k : G → ℝ),
  L.convolution (f - h) k = L.convolution f k - L.convolution h k

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.convolution_sub_right
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G) [inst : Fintype G] (f h k : G → ℝ),
  L.convolution f (h - k) = L.convolution f h - L.convolution f k

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.defect_add_overlap
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype G] (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G) [inst_1 : DecidableEq G] (B : Finset G)
  (g : G), L.defect B g + (B ∩ L.rightTranslate B g).card = B.card

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.defect_inv
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype G] (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G),
  L.DivisionClosed →
    L.Reversible →
      ∀ (B : Finset G) (g : G),
        (∀ b ∈ B, L.Defined b g) → (∀ b ∈ B, L.Defined b (L.inv g)) → L.defect B (L.inv g) = L.defect B g

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.defect_mul_le
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype G] (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G),
  L.Cancellative →
    ∀ {R : Set G},
      L.AllProductsDefined R 3 →
        ∀ (B : Finset G),
          ↑B ⊆ R → ∀ {g h gh : G}, g ∈ R → h ∈ R → L.mulRel g h gh → L.defect B gh ≤ L.defect B g + L.defect B h

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.defect_one
declarations.type: ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype G] (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G) (B : Finset G), L.defect B L.one = 0

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.dense_almost_periods
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype G] (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G),
  L.DivisionClosed →
    L.Reversible →
      ∀ {K : ℕ} (A B : Finset G) (ε t δ : ℝ),
        DirectedCycles.IsLocalFiniteApproximateGroup L K A →
          0 ≤ ε →
            0 ≤ t →
              0 ≤ δ →
                B ⊆ A →
                  t * ↑A.card ≤ ↑B.card →
                    2 * δ * ↑K ≤ t ^ 2 →
                      (∀ C ⊆ A, δ * ↑A.card ≤ ↑C.card → (1 - ε) * ↑(L.finsetMul A B).card ≤ ↑(L.finsetMul A C).card) →
                        ∃ S,
                          L.one ∈ S ∧
                            (∀ g ∈ S, L.inv g ∈ S) ∧
                              ↑S ⊆ L.wordPower (↑A) 2 ∧
                                δ * ↑A.card ≤ ↑S.card ∧
                                  ∀ g ∈ S, ↑(L.defect (L.finsetMul A B) g) ≤ ε * ↑(L.finsetMul A B).card

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.derivativeNorm_commutator_le
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G) [inst : Fintype G],
  L.Cancellative →
    ∀ {R : Set G},
      L.AllProductsDefined R 3 →
        ∀ {g h r s k : G},
          g ∈ R →
            h ∈ R →
              r ∈ R →
                k ∈ R →
                  L.mulRel h g r →
                    L.mulRel g h s →
                      L.mulRel r k s →
                        ∀ (f : G → ℝ),
                          (∀ (x : G), f x ≠ 0 → x ∈ R) →
                            L.derivativeNorm f k ≤
                              L.derivativeNorm (L.derivative h f) g + L.derivativeNorm (L.derivative g f) h

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.derivativeNorm_convolution_le
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype G] (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G),
  L.Cancellative →
    ∀ {R : Set G},
      L.AllProductsDefined R 3 →
        ∀ {h : G},
          h ∈ R →
            ∀ (f k : G → ℝ) (B : Finset G),
              ↑B ⊆ R →
                (∀ (x : G), k x ≠ 0 → x ∈ R) →
                  ∀ {s r : ℝ},
                    0 ≤ s →
                      0 ≤ r →
                        (∀ y ∉ B, f y = 0) →
                          (∀ y ∈ B, |f y| ≤ s) →
                            (∀ y ∈ B, ∃ c ∈ R, ∃ t, L.mulRel h y t ∧ L.mulRel y c t ∧ L.derivativeNorm k c ≤ r) →
                              L.derivativeNorm (L.convolution f k) h ≤ ↑B.card * s * r

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.derivativeNorm_convolution_mass_le
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype G] (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G),
  L.Cancellative →
    ∀ {R : Set G},
      L.AllProductsDefined R 3 →
        ∀ {g : G},
          g ∈ R →
            ∀ (f k : G → ℝ),
              (∀ (x : G), f x ≠ 0 → x ∈ R) →
                (∀ (x : G), k x ≠ 0 → x ∈ R) →
                  (∀ (x : G), 0 ≤ k x) → L.derivativeNorm (L.convolution f k) g ≤ L.derivativeNorm f g * ∑ z, k z

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.derivativeNorm_inv
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G) [inst : Fintype G],
  L.DivisionClosed →
    L.Reversible →
      ∀ (g : G) (f : G → ℝ),
        (∀ (x : G), f x ≠ 0 → L.Defined g x) →
          (∀ (x : G), f x ≠ 0 → L.Defined (L.inv g) x) → L.derivativeNorm f (L.inv g) = L.derivativeNorm f g

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.derivativeNorm_le_escape_of_second
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype G] (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G),
  L.Cancellative →
    ∀ {R S : Set G},
      L.AllProductsDefined R 3 →
        S ⊆ R →
          ∀ {g : G},
            g ∈ R →
              ∀ (f : G → ℝ),
                (∀ (x : G), f x ≠ 0 → x ∈ R) →
                  L.one ∈ S →
                    ∀ {B : ℝ},
                      0 ≤ B →
                        (∀ h ∈ S, L.derivativeNorm (L.derivative g f) h ≤ B) →
                          L.derivativeNorm f g ≤ 4 * ‖f‖ * L.escapeNorm S g + B

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.derivativeNorm_le_iff
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G) [inst : Fintype G] (f : G → ℝ) (g : G) {r : ℝ},
  0 ≤ r → (L.derivativeNorm f g ≤ r ↔ ∀ (x : G), |L.derivative g f x| ≤ r)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.derivativeNorm_le_of_power_segment
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype G] (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G),
  L.Cancellative →
    ∀ {R S : Set G},
      L.AllProductsDefined R 3 →
        S ⊆ R →
          ∀ {g : G},
            g ∈ R →
              ∀ (f : G → ℝ),
                (∀ (x : G), f x ≠ 0 → x ∈ R) →
                  ∀ {B : ℝ},
                    (∀ h ∈ S, L.derivativeNorm (L.derivative g f) h ≤ B) →
                      ∀ {n : ℕ}, 0 < n → (∀ i ≤ n, L.PowerIn S g i) → L.derivativeNorm f g ≤ 2 * ‖f‖ / ↑n + B

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.derivativeNorm_le_two_mul
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G) [inst : Fintype G] (f : G → ℝ) (g : G),
  L.derivativeNorm f g ≤ 2 * ‖f‖

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.derivativeNorm_mul_le
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G) [inst : Fintype G],
  L.Cancellative →
    ∀ {A : Set G},
      L.AllProductsDefined A 3 →
        ∀ {g h gh : G},
          g ∈ A →
            h ∈ A →
              L.mulRel g h gh →
                ∀ (f : G → ℝ),
                  (∀ (x : G), f x ≠ 0 → x ∈ A) → L.derivativeNorm f gh ≤ L.derivativeNorm f g + L.derivativeNorm f h

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.derivativeNorm_nonneg
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G) [inst : Fintype G] (f : G → ℝ) (g : G),
  0 ≤ L.derivativeNorm f g

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.derivativeNorm_normalizedConvolution_le
declarations.type:

                            L.Product [L.inv g, L.inv h, g, h] k →

            S ⊆ ↑A →
              L.one ∈ Q →

                  ∀ (C M N : ℕ),

                        0 < N →

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.leftShift_mul
declarations.type:

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.many_overlapping_right_translates
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype G] (L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G) [inst_1 : DecidableEq G],
  L.Cancellative →
    ∀ {K : ℕ} {A B : Finset G},
      DirectedCycles.IsLocalFiniteApproximateGroup L K A →
        ∀ (t δ : ℝ),
          0 ≤ t →
            0 ≤ δ →
              B ⊆ A →
                t * ↑A.card ≤ ↑B.card →
                  2 * δ * ↑K ≤ t ^ 2 →
                    ∃ a ∈ A,
                      δ * ↑A.card ≤ ↑{b ∈ A | δ * ↑A.card ≤ ↑(L.rightTranslate B a ∩ L.rightTranslate B b).card}.card

  2 ≤ l.length →
    (L.Product (List.map f l) x ↔
      ∀ (k : Fin (l.length + 1)),
        0 < ↑k →
          ↑k < l.length →
            ∃ u v,
              L.Product (List.map f (List.take (↑k) l)) u ∧
                L.Product (List.map f (List.drop (↑k) l)) v ∧ L.mulRel u v x)

declarations.type:

  (A : Set G),
  1 ∈ A →
    A⁻¹ = A →
      ∀ (M : ℕ),

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.eval_mul_marked_mod_next
declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [inst_1 : N.Normal]
  (w : DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord α) (x : α → G) (u v : G),
  u ∈ N →
    v ∈ N →
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.relativeSeries N (w.degree + 1)))
          (DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.eval (u * v) x w) =
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.relativeSeries N (w.degree + 1)))
            (DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.eval u x w) *
          (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.relativeSeries N (w.degree + 1)))
            (DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.eval v x w)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.eval_mul_variable_mod_next
declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {G : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [inst_2 : N.Normal]
  (w : DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord α),
  w.leafLabels.Nodup →
    ∀ h ∈ N,
      ∀ (x : α → G),
        ∀ i ∈ w.leafLabels,
          ∀ (u v : G),
            (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.relativeSeries N (w.degree + 1)))
                (DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.eval h (Function.update x i (u * v)) w) =
              (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.relativeSeries N (w.degree + 1)))
                  (DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.eval h (Function.update x i u) w) *
                (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.relativeSeries N (w.degree + 1)))
                  (DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.eval h (Function.update x i v) w)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.eval_update_one_of_mem
declarations.type:

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.imageMultihom_apply
declarations.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] {B : ι → Type u}

  (DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.imageMultihom φ w hw hall hnext).toFun x =
    DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.eval (φ.toFun fun i => x (Sum.inl i)) (fun i => x (Sum.inr i)) w

declarations.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] {B : ι → Type u}

declarations.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] {B : ι → Type u}

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.short_values_lift
declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} {Q : Type u_3} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Group Q]
  (w : DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord α) (f : G →* Q) (H : Subgroup G) (A : Set G),
  1 ∈ A →
    A⁻¹ = A →
      ↑H ⊆ A →
        DirectedCycles.relativeSeries (Subgroup.normalClosure ↑H) (w.degree + 1) = ⊥ →
          ∀ h ∈ Subgroup.map f H,
            ∀ (x : α → Q),
              (∀ (i : α), x i ∈ (⇑f '' A) ^ 4) →
                DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.eval h x w ∈
                  ⇑f '' (A ^ (4 ^ (w.degree + 1) * 4) ∩ ↑(Subgroup.center G))

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.subgroupTerminalMultihom_apply
declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {G : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Group G] (H : Subgroup G)
  (w : DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord α) (hw : w.leafLabels.Nodup) (hall : ∀ (i : α), i ∈ w.leafLabels)
  (hnext : DirectedCycles.relativeSeries (Subgroup.normalClosure ↑H) (w.degree + 1) = ⊥)
  (x : (i : Option α) → DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.Input H α i),
  (DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.subgroupTerminalMultihom H w hw hall hnext).toFun x =
    DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.eval (↑(x none)) (fun i => x (some i)) w

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.subgroupTerminalMultihom_central
declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {G : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Group G] (H : Subgroup G)

  (hnext : DirectedCycles.relativeSeries (Subgroup.normalClosure ↑H) (w.degree + 1) = ⊥),

declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {G : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Group G] (H : Subgroup G) (l : List α) (hl : l.Nodup)
  (hall : ∀ (i : α), i ∈ l) (hnext : DirectedCycles.relativeSeries (Subgroup.normalClosure ↑H) (l.length + 1) = ⊥),
  Subgroup.closure
      (Set.range

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.subgroupTerminalMultihom_range
declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {G : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Group G] (H : Subgroup G)
  (w : DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord α) (hw : w.leafLabels.Nodup) (hall : ∀ (i : α), i ∈ w.leafLabels)
  (hnext : DirectedCycles.relativeSeries (Subgroup.normalClosure ↑H) (w.degree + 1) = ⊥),
  Set.range (DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.subgroupTerminalMultihom H w hw hall hnext).toFun =
    {z | ∃ h ∈ H, ∃ x, DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.eval h x w = z}

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.terminal_width_of_short_generators
declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] {G : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Group G] [inst_3 : Finite G]
  (H : Subgroup G) (w : DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord α) (hw : w.leafLabels.Nodup)
  (hall : ∀ (i : α), i ∈ w.leafLabels)
  (hnext : DirectedCycles.relativeSeries (Subgroup.normalClosure ↑H) (w.degree + 1) = ⊥) (A : Set G)
  (U : Subgroup (Abelianization G)) (k : ℕ) (x : Fin k → G),
  ↑U ⊆ ⇑Abelianization.of '' A ^ 4 →
    (∀ (i : Fin k), x i ∈ A ^ 4) →
      Subgroup.closure (↑U ∪ Set.range fun i => Abelianization.of (x i)) = ⊤ →
        ∀ T ≤ Subgroup.center G,
          ∀ (r M : ℕ),
            Group.rank ↥T ≤ r →
              (∀ (h : ↥H) (y : α → G),
                  (∀ (i : α), y i ∈ A ^ 4) →
                    DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.eval (↑h) y w ∈ T ∧
                      DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.eval (↑h) y w ∈ A ^ M) →
                ↑(Subgroup.closure
                      (Set.range
                        (DirectedCycles.MarkedCommutatorWord.subgroupTerminalMultihom H w hw hall hnext).toFun)) ⊆
                  A ^ ((k + 1) ^ Fintype.card α * (M * r))

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.OneParameter.comp_productApprox

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.OneParameter.eval_add

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.OneParameter.eval_nat_mul

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.OneParameter.eval_rat

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.OneParameter.eval_sub
declarations.type:

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.OneParameter.productApprox_nat_mul
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] (φ ψ : DirectedCycles.OneParameter G) (t : ℝ) (k n : ℕ),
  0 < k → 0 < n → φ.productApprox ψ (↑k * t) (k * n) = φ.productApprox ψ t n ^ k

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.OneParameter.productApprox_neg
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] (φ ψ : DirectedCycles.OneParameter G) (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ),
  (φ.productApprox ψ (-t) n)⁻¹ = ψ.eval (t / ↑n) * φ.productApprox ψ t n * (ψ.eval (t / ↑n))⁻¹

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.OneParameter.productApprox_one
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] (φ : DirectedCycles.OneParameter G) (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ),

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.OneParameter.productApprox_same_scales
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] (a b : ℝ) (φ : DirectedCycles.OneParameter G) (t : ℝ)
  (n : ℕ),
  0 < n →
    (DirectedCycles.OneParameter.scale a φ).productApprox (DirectedCycles.OneParameter.scale b φ) t n =
      (DirectedCycles.OneParameter.scale (a + b) φ).eval t

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.OneParameter.productApprox_scale
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] (c : ℝ) (φ ψ : DirectedCycles.OneParameter G) (t : ℝ)
  (n : ℕ),

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.OneParameter.productApprox_swap
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace G] (φ ψ : DirectedCycles.OneParameter G) (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ),
  ψ.productApprox φ t n = ψ.eval (t / ↑n) * φ.productApprox ψ t n * (ψ.eval (t / ↑n))⁻¹

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.OneParameter.productApprox_zero

  {S : I → I → Set G} {root : I} (R : DirectedCycles.ReturnSpine S root) (q : G →* H),
  Function.Surjective ⇑q →
    DirectedCycles.StronglyConnected (DirectedCycles.VoltageDigraph S) →
      ∃ T,
        (∀ s ∈ T, q s ≠ 1) ∧
          Subgroup.closure (⇑q '' T) = ⊤ ∧
            ∀ s ∈ T,

  (R : DirectedCycles.ReturnSpine S root) (x x' : G) (i j i' j' : I) (s s' : G),
  ∀ z ∈ R.walkVertices x i j s,

declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Finite G] {a : G}
  {S : Set (G ⧸ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)} {C : DirectedCycles.Cycle (DirectedCycles.CayleyDigraph S)}
  {s : Fin C.length → G}
  {hstep :
    ∀ (i : Fin C.length),
      C.vertex ((finRotate C.length) i) = C.vertex i * (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) (s i)}
  {t : J → G} {D : ℕ} (X : DirectedCycles.SeparatedLiftInput a S C s hstep t D) (T : Set G),
  (∀ (i : Fin C.length), s i ∈ T) →
    2 * D + 2 ≤ orderOf ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a) →
      ∀ (Q : DirectedCycles.Cycle (DirectedCycles.cyclicAuxiliaryGraph a D X.data ⋯)),
        ∃ L,
          Q.length ≤ L.length ∧
            L.ClosedUnderGenerator a ∧
              ∀ (e : Fin L.length),
                L.vertex ((finRotate L.length) e) = L.vertex e * a ∨
                  ∃ i,
                    ∃ u ≤ D,
                      L.vertex ((finRotate L.length) e) = L.vertex e * s i ∧
                        (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) (L.vertex e) =
                            DirectedCycles.residuePower ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a)
                                (X.residues i + ↑u) *
                              (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a))
                                (List.take (↑i) (List.ofFn s)).prod ∧
                          (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a))
                              (L.vertex ((finRotate L.length) e)) =
                            DirectedCycles.residuePower ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a)
                                (X.residues i + ↑u) *
                              (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a))
                                (List.take (↑i + 1) (List.ofFn s)).prod

    ∀ (i : Fin C.length),
      C.vertex ((finRotate C.length) i) = C.vertex i * (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) (s i)}
  {t : J → G} {D : ℕ} (self : DirectedCycles.SeparatedLiftInput a S C s hstep t D)
  (c :
    DirectedCycles.RightCollision
      (DirectedCycles.cycleSourceEmbedding (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) S C s hstep)
      (DirectedCycles.cycleTargetEmbedding (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) S C s hstep) fun j =>

  (∀ z ∈ P.vertices, z.1 = 1 ∨ z.1 = s * (t z.2)⁻¹) →

  t root = 1 →
    (∀ z ∈ P.vertices, z.1 = 1 ∨ z.1 = s * (t z.2)⁻¹) →

  [inst_1 : Group H] (P : DirectedCycles.SimplePath (DirectedCycles.VoltageDigraph S) (1, root) (s, root)) (q : G →* H),
  (List.map (fun z => (q z.1, z.2)) P.vertices).Nodup →
    ∀ (x y : G), q x = q y → x ≠ y → (P.translateRoot x).vertices.Disjoint (P.translateRoot y).vertices

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.SimplePath.translates_disjoint_of_no_mixed
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {I : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] {S : I → I → Set G} {root : I} {s s' : G}
  (P : DirectedCycles.SimplePath (DirectedCycles.VoltageDigraph S) (1, root) (s, root))
  (Q : DirectedCycles.SimplePath (DirectedCycles.VoltageDigraph S) (1, root) (s', root)) (t : I → G),
  (∀ z ∈ P.vertices, z.1 = 1 ∨ z.1 = s * (t z.2)⁻¹) →
    (∀ z ∈ Q.vertices, z.1 = 1 ∨ z.1 = s' * (t z.2)⁻¹) →
      ∀ (x y : G),
        x ≠ y →
          x * s ≠ y * s' →

  [inst_2 : IsTopologicalGroup G] [inst_3 : LocallyCompactSpace G] [inst_4 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_5 : NormedSpace ℝ E] (e : DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra D ≃L[ℝ] E) (x y : E),
  DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.coordinateLeftDifference D e x y =
    DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.coordinateLog D e
      ((DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.coordinateExp D e x)⁻¹ * DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.coordinateExp D e y)

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.coordinateLeftDifference_hasFDerivAt._abel_1_1
declarations.type:

  [inst_2 : IsTopologicalGroup G] [inst_3 : LocallyCompactSpace G] [inst_4 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_5 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (e : DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra D ≃L[ℝ] E)
  (x h : E),
  DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.coordinateLeftDifference D e x (x + h) -
        (DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.coordinateAdjointAverage D e (x + h)) h +
      ((DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.coordinateAdjointAverage D e (x + h)) h -
        (DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.coordinateAdjointAverage D e x) h) =
    DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.coordinateLeftDifference D e x (x + h) - 0 -
      (DirectedCycles.GleasonLieAlgebra.coordinateAdjointAverage D e x) h

  L.DivisionClosed →
    L.Reversible →
      ∀ (B : Finset G) {K : ℕ},
        DirectedCycles.IsStrongLocalFiniteApproximateGroup L K B →
          ∀ {C C₀ : ℝ},
            0 ≤ C →
              0 ≤ C₀ →
                (∀ y ∈ D.finiteImage B,
                    ∃ x,
                      ↑x ∈ B ∧ D.project x = y ∧ L.escapeNorm ↑B ↑x ≤ C * D.algebra.escapeNorm (↑(D.finiteImage B)) y) →
                  ∀ (r : ℕ),
                    ∃ T,
                      3 ≤ T ∧
                        ∀ (g : Fin r → D.Carrier) (N : Fin r → ℕ),
                          (∀ (i : Fin r), g i ∈ D.finiteImage B) →
                            (∀ (i : Fin r), ∀ m ≤ N i, D.algebra.PowerIn (↑(D.finiteImage B)) (g i) m) →
                              ∀ (u : ↑D.small) (n : ℕ),
                                L.escapeNorm ↑B ↑u ≤ C₀ / (↑n + 1) →
                                  ∃ v,
                                    v (Fin.last r) = u ∧
                                      (∀ (i : Fin r), D.project (v i.castSucc) = g i) ∧
                                        L.SignedWordsIn (fun i => ↑(v i)) (fun i => Fin.lastCases n N i / T) ↑B ∧
                                          (L.wordProgression (fun i => ↑(v i)) fun i => Fin.lastCases n N i / T) ⊆ ↑B

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.localComponentModel_neighbourhood
declarations.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (U : Ultrafilter ι) (G : ι → Type u_2) (L : (i : ι) → DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra (G i))
  (P : (i : ι) → Set (G i)) (D : (i : ι) → (L i).CentralQuotientData (P i)) (hd : ∀ (i : ι), (L i).DivisionClosed)
  (hr : ∀ (i : ι), (L i).Reversible) {H : Type u_3} {M : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra H} {Q : Set H}
  (T : M.CentralQuotientData Q),
  M.DivisionClosed →
    ∀ (π : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupHom (DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L) M)
      (hPQ : ∀ p ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G P, π.toFun p ∈ Q)
      (hDW :
        ∀ x ∈ (DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.ultraproduct U G L P D).small, π.toFun x ∈ T.small),
      Q ⊆ π.toFun '' DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G P →
        (∀ (i : ι), ∀ p ∈ P i, (L i).inv p ∈ P i) →
          ∀ (A B : (i : ι) → Finset (G i)),
            (∀ (i : ι), P i ⊆ ↑(A i)) →
              (∀ (i : ι), (D i).small ⊆ ↑(A i)) →
                (∀ (i : ι), ∀ x ∈ A i, (L i).inv x ∈ A i) →
                  (∀ (i : ι), (L i).AllProductsDefined (↑(A i)) 2) →
                    (∀ (i : ι), ↑(B i) ⊆ (D i).small) →
                      ∀ (V : Set H),
                        (∀ (x : DirectedCycles.LocalUltraproduct (↑U) G),
                            π.toFun x ∈ V → x ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(B i)) →
                          (∀ v ∈ V, ∃ x, π.toFun x = v) →
                            have Ψ :=
                              ((DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.ultraproduct U G L P
                                        D).localModelQuotientHom
                                    T π hPQ hDW).comp
                                (DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.quotientUltraHom U G L P D hd hr);
                            have Vq := T.project '' {v | ↑v ∈ V};
                            (Ψ.toFun ⁻¹' Vq ⊆
                                DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) (fun i => (D i).Carrier) fun i =>
                                  ↑((D i).finiteImage (B i))) ∧
                              Vq ⊆
                                Ψ.toFun ''
                                  DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) (fun i => (D i).Carrier) fun i =>
                                    ↑((D i).finiteImage (B i))

declarations.type:

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.localModelQuotientHom_internal_sandwich
declarations.type:

  (P : (i : ι) → Set (G i)) (D : (i : ι) → (L i).CentralQuotientData (P i)) (hd : ∀ (i : ι), (L i).DivisionClosed)
  (hr : ∀ (i : ι), (L i).Reversible) {H : Type u_3} [inst : TopologicalSpace H] {M : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra H}
  {Q : Set H} (T : M.CentralQuotientData Q),
  IsOpen T.small →
    ∀ [T2Space T.Carrier] (π : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupHom (DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L) M)
      (hPQ : ∀ p ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G P, π.toFun p ∈ Q)
      (hDW :
        ∀ x ∈ (DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.ultraproduct U G L P D).small, π.toFun x ∈ T.small)
      (C : Set ↑T.small),
      IsCompact C →
        (∀ (x : ↑(DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.ultraproduct U G L P D).small),
            ⟨π.toFun ↑x, ⋯⟩ ∈ C) →
          (∀ (F O : Set H),
              IsCompact F →
                IsOpen O →
                  F ⊆ O →
                    O ⊆ T.small →
                      ∃ B,
                        (π.toFun ⁻¹' F ⊆ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(B i)) ∧
                          (DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(B i)) ⊆ π.toFun ⁻¹' O) →
            have Ψ :=
              ((DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.ultraproduct U G L P D).localModelQuotientHom T π
                    hPQ hDW).comp
                (DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.quotientUltraHom U G L P D hd hr);
            ∀ (F O : Set T.Carrier),
              IsCompact F →
                IsOpen O →
                  F ⊆ O →
                    ∃ B,
                      (Ψ.toFun ⁻¹' F ⊆ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) (fun i => (D i).Carrier) fun i => ↑(B i)) ∧
                        (DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) (fun i => (D i).Carrier) fun i => ↑(B i)) ⊆ Ψ.toFun ⁻¹' O

declarations.type:

  (π : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupHom L M) (hPQ : ∀ p ∈ P, π.toFun p ∈ Q) (hDW : ∀ x ∈ D.small, π.toFun x ∈ T.small)
