declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.localModelQuotientHom_local_internal_sandwich
declarations.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (U : Ultrafilter ι) (G : ι → Type u_2) (L : (i : ι) → DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra (G i))
  (P : (i : ι) → Set (G i)) (D : (i : ι) → (L i).CentralQuotientData (P i)) (hd : ∀ (i : ι), (L i).DivisionClosed)
  (hr : ∀ (i : ι), (L i).Reversible) {H : Type u_3} [inst : TopologicalSpace H] [T2Space H]
  {M : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra H} {Q : Set H} (T : M.CentralQuotientData Q),
  IsOpen T.small →
    ∀ [T2Space T.Carrier] (π : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupHom (DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L) M)
      (hPQ : ∀ p ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G P, π.toFun p ∈ Q)
      (hDW :
        ∀ x ∈ (DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.ultraproduct U G L P D).small, π.toFun x ∈ T.small)
      (C : Set ↑T.small),
      IsCompact C →
        (∀ (x : ↑(DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.ultraproduct U G L P D).small),
            ⟨π.toFun ↑x, ⋯⟩ ∈ C) →
          ∀ (U₀ : Set H),
            IsOpen U₀ →
              Subtype.val '' C ⊆ U₀ →
                (∀ (F O : Set H),
                    IsCompact F →
                      IsOpen O →
                        F ⊆ O →
                          O ⊆ U₀ →
                            ∃ B,
                              (π.toFun ⁻¹' F ⊆ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(B i)) ∧
                                (DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) G fun i => ↑(B i)) ⊆ π.toFun ⁻¹' O) →
                  have Ψ :=
                    ((DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.ultraproduct U G L P D).localModelQuotientHom
                          T π hPQ hDW).comp
                      (DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.quotientUltraHom U G L P D hd hr);
                  ∀ (F O : Set T.Carrier),
                    IsCompact F →
                      IsOpen O →
                        F ⊆ O →
                          ∃ B,
                            (Ψ.toFun ⁻¹' F ⊆
                                DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) (fun i => (D i).Carrier) fun i => ↑(B i)) ∧
                              (DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) (fun i => (D i).Carrier) fun i => ↑(B i)) ⊆
                                Ψ.toFun ⁻¹' O

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.localModelQuotientHom_neighbourhood
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} {L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G} {M : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra H}
  {P : Set G} {Q : Set H} (D : L.CentralQuotientData P) (T : M.CentralQuotientData Q),
  L.DivisionClosed →
    M.DivisionClosed →
      ∀ (π : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupHom L M) (hPQ : ∀ p ∈ P, π.toFun p ∈ Q)
        (hDW : ∀ x ∈ D.small, π.toFun x ∈ T.small),
        Q ⊆ π.toFun '' P →
          (∀ p ∈ P, L.inv p ∈ P) →
            ∀ (A B : Set G),
              P ⊆ A →
                D.small ⊆ A →
                  (∀ x ∈ A, L.inv x ∈ A) →
                    (∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, L.Defined x y) →
                      B ⊆ D.small →
                        ∀ (V : Set H),
                          (∀ (x : G), π.toFun x ∈ V → x ∈ B) →
                            (∀ v ∈ V, ∃ x, π.toFun x = v) →
                              have Vq := T.project '' {v | ↑v ∈ V};
                              (D.localModelQuotientHom T π hPQ hDW).toFun ⁻¹' Vq ⊆ D.project '' {x | ↑x ∈ B} ∧
                                Vq ⊆ (D.localModelQuotientHom T π hPQ hDW).toFun '' D.project '' {x | ↑x ∈ B}

declarations.type:

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.local_to_local_component_kernel_of_quotient_kernel

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.local_to_local_component_projected_negligible_escape_kernel
declarations.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (U : Ultrafilter ι) (G : ι → Type u_2) (L : (i : ι) → DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra (G i))
  (P : (i : ι) → Set (G i)) (D : (i : ι) → (L i).CentralQuotientData (P i)) (B : (i : ι) → Finset (G i))
  (u : (i : ι) → G i) (N : ι → ℕ) (p : (i : ι) → (L i).PowerSegment (u i) (N i)) (hu : ∀ (i : ι), u i ∈ (D i).small),
  (∀ (i : ι), ∀ n ≤ N i, (p i).power n ∈ (D i).small) →
    (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, (D i).algebra.one ∈ (D i).finiteImage (B i)) →
      (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, 0 < N i) →
        (∀ (ε : ℝ),
            0 < ε →
              ∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U,
                (D i).algebra.escapeNorm (↑((D i).finiteImage (B i))) ((D i).project ⟨u i, ⋯⟩) * ↑(N i) < ε) →
          ∀ {H : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} (R : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra H)
            (M : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra T)
            (π : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupHom (DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L) R)
            (Ψ :
              DirectedCycles.LocalGroupHom
                (DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) (fun i => (D i).Carrier) fun i => (D i).algebra) M)
            (Q : Set H),
            (∀ (a : (i : ι) → ↑(D i).small),
                Ψ.toFun (DirectedCycles.localUltraMk (↑U) (fun i => (D i).Carrier) fun i => (D i).project (a i)) =
                    M.one →
                  π.toFun (DirectedCycles.localUltraMk (↑U) G fun i => ↑(a i)) ∈ Q) →
              ∀ (V : Set T),
                (∀ (x : T) (q : M.PowerSequence x), (∀ (n : ℕ), q.power n ∈ V) → x = M.one) →
                  (∀ z ∈ DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) (fun i => (D i).Carrier) fun i => ↑((D i).finiteImage (B i)),
                      Ψ.toFun z ∈ V) →
                    π.toFun (DirectedCycles.localUltraMk (↑U) G fun i => (p i).power (N i)) ∈ Q

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.local_to_local_component_projected_negligible_lift_and_exit_kernel
declarations.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (U : Ultrafilter ι) (G : ι → Type u_2) (L : (i : ι) → DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra (G i))
  (P : (i : ι) → Set (G i)) (D : (i : ι) → (L i).CentralQuotientData (P i)) (B : (i : ι) → Finset (G i))
  (u : (i : ι) → G i) (N : ι → ℕ) (p : (i : ι) → (L i).PowerSegment (u i) (N i)) (hu : ∀ (i : ι), u i ∈ (D i).small),
  (∀ (i : ι), ∀ n ≤ N i, (p i).power n ∈ (D i).small) →
    (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, (D i).algebra.one ∈ (D i).finiteImage (B i)) →
      (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U, 0 < N i) →
        (∀ (i : ι), (L i).escapeNorm (↑(B i)) (u i) = 1 / ↑(N i)) →
          (∀ (ε : ℝ),
              0 < ε →
                ∀ᶠ (i : ι) in ↑U,
                  (D i).algebra.escapeNorm (↑((D i).finiteImage (B i))) ((D i).project ⟨u i, ⋯⟩) <
                    ε * (L i).escapeNorm (↑(B i)) (u i)) →
            ∀ {H : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} (R : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra H)
              (M : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra T)
              (π : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupHom (DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) G L) R)
              (Ψ :
                DirectedCycles.LocalGroupHom
                  (DirectedCycles.localUltraAlgebra (↑U) (fun i => (D i).Carrier) fun i => (D i).algebra) M)
              (Q : Set H),
              (∀ (a : (i : ι) → ↑(D i).small),
                  Ψ.toFun (DirectedCycles.localUltraMk (↑U) (fun i => (D i).Carrier) fun i => (D i).project (a i)) =
                      M.one →
                    π.toFun (DirectedCycles.localUltraMk (↑U) G fun i => ↑(a i)) ∈ Q) →
                ∀ (V : Set T),
                  (∀ (x : T) (q : M.PowerSequence x), (∀ (n : ℕ), q.power n ∈ V) → x = M.one) →
                    (∀
                        z ∈
                          DirectedCycles.localUltraSet (↑U) (fun i => (D i).Carrier) fun i =>
                            ↑((D i).finiteImage (B i)),
                        Ψ.toFun z ∈ V) →
                      π.toFun (DirectedCycles.localUltraMk (↑U) G u) ∈ Q ∧
                        π.toFun (DirectedCycles.localUltraMk (↑U) G fun i => (p i).power (N i)) ∈ Q

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.minimal_lift_excludes_corrected_segment
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G} {P : Set G} (D : L.CentralQuotientData P),
  L.DivisionClosed →
    ∀ (B : Finset G),
      ↑B ⊆ D.small →
        ∀ (g : ↑D.small),
          ↑g ∈ B →
            (∀ (z : ↑D.small), ↑z ∈ B → D.project z = D.project g → L.escapeNorm ↑B ↑g ≤ L.escapeNorm ↑B ↑z) →
              ∀ {h c : G},
                c ∈ P →
                  L.mulRel c (↑g) h →
                    ∀ {M : ℕ},
                      0 < M → ∀ (p : L.PowerSegment h M), (∀ n ≤ M, p.power n ∈ B) → L.escapeNorm ↑B ↑g = 1 / ↑M → False

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra.CentralQuotientData.modelQuotientHom_image
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} {L : DirectedCycles.LocalGroupAlgebra G} [inst : Group H] {P : Set G}

declarations.name: DirectedCycles.SeparatedLiftInput.mk.sizeOf_spec
declarations.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Finite G] {a : G}
  {S : Set (G ⧸ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)} {C : DirectedCycles.Cycle (DirectedCycles.CayleyDigraph S)}
  {s : Fin C.length → G}
  {hstep :
    ∀ (i : Fin C.length),
      C.vertex ((finRotate C.length) i) = C.vertex i * (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) (s i)}
  {t : J → G} {D : ℕ} [inst_2 : SizeOf G] [inst_3 : SizeOf J]
  [inst_4 : (a : G ⧸ DirectedCycles.elementClosure a) → SizeOf (S a)] (runs : Fin C.length → ℕ)
  (residues : Fin C.length → ZMod (orderOf ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a))) (closing : ℤ)
  (endpoint :
    (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) (List.ofFn s).prod =
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a ^ closing)
  (bounds :
    ∀ (i : Fin C.length),
      D ≤ runs i ∧
        (orderOf ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a) + 7) / 8 ≤ runs i ∧
          runs i ≤ orderOf ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a) - 2 * D - 2)
  (congruence :
    ↑(orderOf ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a)) ∣ ↑(∑ i, (runs i + D)) + closing)
  (total : C.length * orderOf ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a) ≤ 8 * ∑ i, (runs i + 1))
  (prefix_residues : ∀ (i : Fin C.length), ↑(DirectedCycles.runPrefixSum runs D i.castSucc) + ↑(runs i) = residues i)
  (run_residues :
    ∀ (i : Fin C.length),
      ↑(runs i) = residues i - residues ((Equiv.symm (finRotate C.length)) i) - ↑D - if ↑i = 0 then ↑closing else 0)
  (offsets :
    (DirectedCycles.RightCollision
        (DirectedCycles.cycleSourceEmbedding (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) S C s hstep)
        (DirectedCycles.cycleTargetEmbedding (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) S C s hstep) fun j =>
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) (t j)) →
      ZMod (orderOf ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a)))
  (offset_eq :
    ∀
      (c :
        DirectedCycles.RightCollision
          (DirectedCycles.cycleSourceEmbedding (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) S C s hstep)
          (DirectedCycles.cycleTargetEmbedding (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) S C s hstep)
          fun j => (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) (t j)),
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) (List.take (↑(↑c).2.1) (List.ofFn s)).prod *
            (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) (t (↑c).1) *
          ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) (List.take (↑(↑c).2.2 + 1) (List.ofFn s)).prod)⁻¹ =
        DirectedCycles.residuePower ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a) (offsets c))
  (avoid :
    ∀
      (c :
        DirectedCycles.RightCollision
          (DirectedCycles.cycleSourceEmbedding (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) S C s hstep)
          (DirectedCycles.cycleTargetEmbedding (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) S C s hstep)
          fun j => (QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementClosure a)) (t j)),
      residues (↑c).2.2 - residues (↑c).2.1 ∉
        DirectedCycles.collisionForbiddenResidues
          (orderOf ((QuotientGroup.mk' (DirectedCycles.elementCommutators a)) a)) D (offsets c)),
  sizeOf
      { runs := runs, residues := residues, closing := closing, endpoint := endpoint, bounds := bounds,
        congruence := congruence, total := total, prefix_residues := prefix_residues, run_residues := run_residues,
